jobs.desc:
About Diamond

Founded in 1974, Diamond Concrete Sawing is one of the Midwest's most trusted concrete sawing and cutting companies. We are family owned, based in Grand Rapids with branches around the state, and our locating work runs under Diamond Locating Services. We saw, drill, and cut concrete on some of the most demanding projects in Michigan, including a lot of MDOT highway and public works, and we locate what is underneath before anyone digs.

We are a company of about 30 people. That means no layers to work through and no waiting a week on a decision. You will know everyone here by name, including the operators running the work you quote.

The Role

This is an estimating and quoting role first, and a sales role second. Every quote at Diamond runs through this seat, whether it came from our outside sales rep, our Director of Service, a bid board, or a contractor who called in cold. The number has to be right, and it has to go out the same day.

You own a job from the moment it is found until it is sold and handed to Service. The first phone call, the questions that define the scope, the quote, the follow-up, and the handoff to dispatch all sit with you. You are the first impression most customers get of us.

The phone rings all day and priorities move. This seat fields inbound calls and email requests, carries a large book of open quotes at a time, and one crew hitting something unexpected in the field can reshuffle your afternoon. If you want a predictable desk, this is not it.

What You Will Do

* Own inbound customer requests and respond the same day.
* Confirm scope, location, access, timing, and special requirements before you quote. Call the client back the same day for anything missing, and ask the questions that change the number.
* Prepare and send quotes for the whole team.
* Follow up on every open quote you own until it is won or lost, and review the losses to find out why.
* Seek out new work daily through bid platforms and other lead sources.
*

**Not sure what you want to do for a career? That's okay.**

Most people don't grow up thinking about a career in mechanical construction. But it's a huge industry with some great opportunities, and you don't need a college degree or construction experience to get started.

We're looking for someone who wants to grow into more responsibility, not necessarily someone who wants to be an assistant for the next 10 years.

jobs.title: Bookkeeper
jobs.desc:
We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Construction Bookkeeper to manage the financial records for our construction businesses.

This position requires someone who can go beyond basic bookkeeping. We need someone who can review every job, track all expenses and income, reconcile bank and credit card transactions, and determine the actual profit or loss on each construction project.

Our goal is to have a clear understanding of where every dollar is going and how profitable each job and business is on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.

Responsibilities:

Review and organize all financial transactions for our construction businesses.

Track every construction project individually.

Review all credit card transactions and identify which job each expense belongs to.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, deposits, and payments.

Track material costs, labor, subcontractors, equipment, fuel, permits, and other job expenses.

Compare actual job costs against original estimates and budgets.

Calculate the profitability of every construction project.

Identify jobs that are losing money or going over budget.

Track customer payments, outstanding invoices, and accounts payable.

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports.

Provide accurate profit-and-loss reports for each job and each company.

Identify discrepancies, duplicate charges, missing receipts, and unnecessary expenses.

Work closely with ownership to provide accurate financial information for business decisions.

Qualifications:

Previous bookkeeping experience required.

Construction industry bookkeeping experience strongly preferred.

Experience with QuickBooks and construction job costing.

Strong understanding of profit-and-loss statements.

Experience reconciling bank accounts and credit card statements.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to analyze numbers and identify problems.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of financial reporting.

We are an outsourced accounting and controller services firm serving construction and home service businesses with $2M–$20M in annual revenue. jobs.desc:
Construction Accountant

Rainey Design Group LLC · Hayden, Idaho

The role

We design and build homes in North Idaho, , and we also hold and develop real estate across several entities. You would own the accounting for all of it.

This is a construction accounting job, not general bookkeeping. If you have not built a WIP schedule, worked with lender draws or chased a lien waiver before, this is not the right fit.

Responsibilities

**WIP and job costing**

* Maintain the work-in-progress schedule: cost to date, estimated cost to complete, percentage of completion, over and under billings, and the gross profit fade or gain on every open job
* Reconcile job cost to the general ledger monthly and explain every variance between the budget, the committed cost and the actual
* Flag jobs trending over budget early enough to do something about it, not at closeout
* Track committed cost against purchase orders and report what is left uncommitted on each job

**Accounts payable**

* Process subcontractor and supplier invoices against their purchase orders on a strict monthly cycle: invoices in by the 25th, payment released by the 10th
* Refuse any invoice that is not billed against an open purchase order, and refuse any payment to a subcontractor whose certificate of insurance, workers compensation or Idaho contractor registration has lapsed
* Collect conditional and unconditional lien waivers each cycle and hold payment until they are in hand
* Apply backcharges, holdbacks and retainage, and maintain the documentation behind each one
* Keep the vendor file current: W-9s, insurance expiration dates, license renewals, 1099 preparation at year end

**Accounts receivable and lender draws**

* Prepare owner billings on cost-plus jobs, with the supporting cost detail the contract requires
* Assemble construction loan draw packages, reconcile the draw to the budget and the inspection, and track interest reserve burn against the remaining term
* Track receivables, deposits, allowanc

jobs.title: Field Runner/Full-Time Job Coordinator
jobs.desc:
This is a starting role with a real future. You start as our runner. If you're good, you grow into our full-time Job Coordinator, the person who keeps every job on track.

Read this first. We need someone organized, reliable and trustworthy. If you lose track of things, run late, or don't answer your phone, this isn't for you.

If people describe you as the one who always has it handled, keep reading.

What we do: High-end kitchen and bath remodels in South Jersey. We're growing fast, and we promote from within.

**Your path with us:**

* Weeks 1–2: Runner (paid part-time trial). Learn our crews, our jobs and how we work. It's a chance for both of us to see if it's a fit.
* After 2 weeks: Full-time. If it's working, you go full-time.
* Next: Full-Time Job Coordinator. You run the day-to-day across multiple jobs: scheduling crews, managing materials, keeping clients updated, and making sure every job starts and finishes on time. More responsibility, more pay.

**What you'll do as a runner:**

* Start each day at the shop and meet our crews.
* Get everything set up so crews can start on time.
* Pick up and drop off materials between the shop, suppliers and jobsites.
* Be a friendly, professional face for our clients on site.
* Log notes, deliveries and job updates clearly and on time.
* Be on call when a job needs something fast.

**You're a fit if you:**

* Have a reliable car, a valid license and a clean driving record.
* Are highly organized and detail-oriented.
* Communicate clearly with customers and crews.
* Are comfortable using your phone to log notes and updates.
* Answer calls and show up when you say you will.
* Want to grow into a leadership role, not just clock in.

**Pay:** $18–$28/hr based on experience, with raises as you move up.

**To apply: text (856) 295 - 2284 with:**

* Your name.
* What car you drive.
* One sentence on why people can count on you.
* We only respond to applicants who answer all 3.

jobs.desc:
Job description

Department Overview



Gas Engineering is focused on ensuring the safe and reliable flow of natural gas to our customers. As a part of Gas Engineering, Gas Transmission Engineering is responsible for all aspects of PG&E's gas transmission asset family, including integrity management, pipeline services, threat identification and assessment scoping, process safety, and project engineering and design. The Gas Transmission Engineering and Design group (GTED), part of the Gas Transmission Engineering organization, is focused on providing the technical direction and design of gas transmission pipeline projects and supporting the execution of the work in the field.

The group also provides technical review and approval of project documentation post construction to ensure company records are updated accurately and reflect the scope of work performed. The Design and Drafting group within GTED is responsible for updating record drawings of facilities based on the as-found or as-built condition at the conclusion of the work.



Position Summary



The expert 3D CAD Records & Data Analyst serves as a key liaison between the Records team, Engineering groups, and program leadership within Gas Transmission Engineering and Design. This role supports the integration of 3D modeling into project workflows while managing the end-to-end records lifecycle for engineering deliverables, including check-in/check-out protocols, version control, and data integrity across systems. The Analyst will coordinate SAP tasks related to drawing custody and work order management, maintain and enhance reporting dashboards, and support cross-functional collaboration between engineering, drafting, construction, and records teams. jobs.desc:
**About Professional Diversified Flooring, Inc.**

Professional Diversified Flooring was established in 1981 and is a leading provider of commercial flooring solutions. With a workforce exceeding 70 office employees and over 400 field labor, the company specializes in comprehensive flooring services for commercial spaces throughout Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, Las Vegas, Phoenix, and surrounding areas. Leveraging proprietary technology and a distinctive project management methodology, Professional Diversified Flooring ensures meticulous attention to detail in every undertaking. Our portfolio encompasses a wide range of projects, from corporate offices to casinos and from healthcare to hospitality, positioning us not merely as flooring specialists, but as strategic partners in design and construction adding maximum value to our clients and their clients.

**THE ROLE**
------------

Billing at PDF does two things: it bills, and it collects. The Billing Specialist owns both, end to end, for the projects assigned to them — from verifying the contract, through progress billing, pay applications, portal submission, lien releases and retention, to collecting the money and closing the job.

Roughly 60% of your time is billing, 30% is collecting, and 10% is the compliance paperwork that gates payment in construction. You are the customer-facing voice of our accounting department to General Contractor project accountants and End User AP teams, and the person our Project Managers rely on to turn finished work into cash.

This is not a data-entry job. The volume is real — a proficient specialist produces 150–200 billings and around $3 million a month — but the work is judgment: reading a subcontract's billing terms, knowing how much can reasonably be billed on a job, catching an over-billing before the GC does, and knowing how far to push a collection before escalating.

You will report to our Billing Manager and work alongside a small, tight team in our Irvine office

### **Description**

Our client is a well-established residential home services company in the Ogden area, running HVAC, plumbing, and electrical service across a fleet of more than 60 technicians. They are adding two Dispatchers to a growing dispatch team that keeps the whole operation moving. This is a great fit for an upbeat multitasker who likes fast days, enjoys people, and wants hourly pay plus a weekly performance bonus. jobs.title: Ready-Mix Concrete Driver / Mixer Truck Driver
jobs.desc:
**​Job Summary ​**

**We are seeking a reliable, safety-conscious Ready-Mix Concrete Driver to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for batching support, loading, transporting, and delivering ready-mix concrete to commercial, residential, and infrastructure job sites. You will serve as a primary point of contact on delivery sites, ensuring high-quality customer service, precise slump delivery, and strict adherence to safety standards.**

**​Key Responsibilities**

**​Safe Delivery: Operate a commercial ready-mix concrete truck safely to and from job sites in compliance with DOT regulations and traffic laws. ​**

**Concrete Quality & Slump Control: Inspect concrete loads for proper slump, consistency, and mix specifications before leaving the plant and upon arrival at the delivery site. Add water or admixtures as required under customer/plant direction. ​**

**On-Site Operations: Safely maneuver vehicles on uneven terrain and tight construction sites. Assemble, attach, and clean discharge chutes to pour concrete into forms, pump hoppers, or wheelbarrows.**

**Vehicle Maintenance & Care: Perform required Pre-Trip and Post-Trip inspections (DVIR). Keep the mixer drum, hopper, and exterior washed down to prevent concrete buildup. Report mechanical issues promptly. ​**

**Customer Service & Communication: Maintain professional communication with dispatchers, plant operators, site superintendents, and contractors. Secure signed delivery tickets or electronic receipts. ​**

**Safety Compliance: Adhere to all OSHA, DOT, company, and site-specific safety rules, including wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times. ​**

**Qualifications & Requirements ​Driver's License: Active Class A or Class B Commercial Driver's License (CDL) with an acceptable driving record. (Tanker endorsement or Air Brakes endorsement may be required). ​Medical Certification: Current DOT Medical Card (or ability to pass a DOT physical and drug screen). ​**

Marwood General Construction is a Service Disabled Veteran Owned heavy civil contractor working federal, municipal, and private civil projects across Kitsap and the surrounding counties. Position Summary

The AP & AR Specialist is responsible for ensuring that the accounting system accurately and promptly reflects what the company owes and what it has earned. The position owns accounts payable and the assigned accounts receivable functions. It ensures expenses are properly coded, documented, reconciled, and paid on time, and that completed work and approved changes become timely, accurate customer billings.

The role directly impacts cash flow, cash-flow planning, job-cost accuracy, month-end reporting, vendor relationships, and the company’s ability to understand true project profitability. Unentered invoices understate expenses and liabilities, can make profitability appear stronger than it is, and leave management with an incomplete view of upcoming cash needs; delayed billings and unrecorded receipts hold back or obscure cash the company has already earned. The objective is not speed alone, but accurate, efficient, and consistent processing that keeps the books as close to real time as practical. The first six months of employment are a training period, after which the employee is expected to perform both AP and AR functions with minimal oversight.

* Scan and match invoices, packing slips, and POs; enter approved invoices into Foundation with support attached and maintain organized electronic records.

AMACO is known for being the first to commercially manufacture ceramic and non-ceramic clays, lead-free glazes, electric kilns and potter’s wheels. AMACO is a founding member of the Arts and Creative Materials Institute, which established safety standards for children’s art materials in 1936. Today AMACO continues to manufacture ceramic supplies with the highest standards of quality and safety.

AMACO is a fourth-generation 100-year family-owned and operated company with a strong belief that art and creating art fosters well-being for the individual while enriching society as a whole. Making art facilitates tactile learning, encourages self-expression, develops craft skills and cultivates creativity. We have been in business for over 120 years and have more than 10 manufacturing, fabrication, and shipping plants servicing over 100 construction centers nationwide. Per year, across America, thousands of new buildings sport the familiar Morton M.

**Our full-time Sales Consultants are self‑driven and motivated to increase market share within an assigned geographical territory, while cultivating new customers and developing relationships with long‑standing customers.**

This challenging, yet highly rewarding role works in a team environment that strives to deliver a building to our customer that is unparalleled in quality and backed by superior warranties.

They have the ability to integrate various technologies into their day‑to‑day activities in order to effectively manage complex projects throughout the construction process from pre‑sale to completion.

**Approximately 70% of this role is focused on pre‑sale responsibilities - prospecting, lead generation, customer presentations, solution development, and guiding customers through the early stages of the buying process. The remaining 30% centers on post‑sale project management, ensuring a seamless customer experience by coordinating project details, communicating with internal teams, and supporting the build through to completion.**

**Morton Buildings offers structured, comprehensive training and ongoing support throughout the early years of a Sales Consultant’s career to ensure long‑term success and confidence in the role.** The successful candidate must maintain a willingness to learn and adapt to the constant changes of the construction industry and the evolving needs of multiple markets.

**This sales territory covers the areas within Cape Girardeau, MO; Poplar Bluff, MO; Jackson, TN; and Jonesboro, AR.**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking an experienced Estimator to support preconstruction and estimating efforts for ground-up multifamily and mixed-use construction projects.

This position will be responsible for preparing detailed cost estimates, quantity takeoffs, budgets, bid packages, and subcontractor pricing while collaborating with Project Managers, Superintendents, architects, engineers, and clients.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in multifamily construction estimating, including affordable housing, market-rate apartments, podium construction, wood-frame structures, concrete buildings, and mixed-use developments.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Prepare conceptual, schematic, design development, and final construction estimates.
* Perform detailed quantity takeoffs and analyze labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor costs.
* Review architectural, structural, civil, and MEP drawings and specifications.
* Develop project budgets, bid packages, scope sheets, and cost breakdowns.
* Solicit, review, and level subcontractor and supplier proposals.
* Identify scope gaps, constructability concerns, and potential project risks.
* Participate in value engineering and cost-saving initiatives.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Superintendents, architects, and consultants during preconstruction.
* Assist with subcontractor procurement, negotiations, and buyout.
* Monitor construction market conditions, material pricing, and labor costs.
* Participate in design development meetings, client presentations, and budget reviews.
* Maintain accurate estimating records, historical costs, and project documentation.
* Support project scheduling, construction phasing, and procurement planning.
* Assist with transitioning projects from preconstruction to operations.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Position summary**

Maintain a reliable, coordinated construction schedule supporting Commercial Construction and Production Homes. Integrate PM priorities, field readiness, crew capacity, materials, equipment, and subcontractor availability into an actionable schedule. Keep scheduling and work-order information current in company systems and make constraints visible before they disrupt execution.

**Key responsibilities**

* Maintain the master construction schedule and a rolling two- to four-week look-ahead for both divisions, with daily updates as conditions change.

* Collect and validate scheduling inputs from PMs, field leaders, irrigation teams, procurement, and subcontractors.

* Track prerequisites such as lot or site readiness, approvals, materials, access, equipment, and predecessor work.

* Identify resource conflicts, unrealistic commitments, and idle capacity; present options to the General Manager, Construction Services, for decision.

* Publish approved crew assignments and schedule changes through agreed channels; confirm that affected teams receive updates.

* Coordinate material and equipment timing with responsible owners to align deliveries with confirmed work.

* Maintain work orders, tickets, dates, status, and scheduling records in Aspire or other approved systems.

* Track planned versus actual starts and completions, record delay reasons, and support schedule-performance reporting.

* Support scheduling meetings with a concise list of constraints, decisions required, owners, and deadlines.

* Maintain an accessible record of schedule revisions and commitments; flag incomplete information instead of treating assumptions as confirmed.

* Use Aspire scheduling and work-order data as a planning tool, keeping it current and accurate so it supports schedule decisions rather than serving only as a record.

**Required qualifications**

* Two or more years of scheduling, dispatch, construction administration, project coordination, or comparable op

We are family owned, based in Grand Rapids with branches around the state, and our locating work runs under Diamond Locating Services. We saw, drill, and cut concrete on some of the most demanding projects in Michigan, including a lot of MDOT highway and public works, and we locate what is underneath before anyone digs.

We are a company of about 30 people. That means no layers to work through and no waiting a week on a decision. You will know everyone here by name, including the operators running the work you quote.

The Role

This is an estimating and quoting role first, and a sales role second. Every quote at Diamond runs through this seat, whether it came from our outside sales rep, our Director of Service, a bid board, or a contractor who called in cold. The number has to be right, and it has to go out the same day.

You own a job from the moment it is found until it is sold and handed to Service. The first phone call, the questions that define the scope, the quote, the follow-up, and the handoff to dispatch all sit with you. You are the first impression most customers get of us.

The phone rings all day and priorities move. This seat fields inbound calls and email requests, carries a large book of open quotes at a time, and one crew hitting something unexpected in the field can reshuffle your afternoon. If you want a predictable desk, this is not it.

What You Will Do

* Own inbound customer requests and respond the same day.
* Confirm scope, location, access, timing, and special requirements before you quote. Call the client back the same day for anything missing, and ask the questions that change the number.
* Prepare and send quotes for the whole team.
* Follow up on every open quote you own until it is won or lost, and review the losses to find out why.
* Seek out new work daily through bid platforms and other lead sources.

**About Prime Data Centers**

Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership.

**About the role**

The Data Center Construction Scheduler is responsible for supporting the planning, scheduling, and execution of large-scale data center construction projects. This role ensures that all phases of construction are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with budgetary and resource constraints.

**What you'll do**

* Develop, manage, and update detailed construction schedules.
* Coordinate with general contractors, subcontractors, engineers, architects, and project managers to gather input and update project timelines.
* Integrate procurement and permitting timelines into the master project schedule.
* Analyze schedule impacts due to design changes, field conditions, or delays and propose mitigation strategies.
* Generate and distribute regular schedule reports, including look-aheads, critical path analyses, and schedule risk assessments.
* Facilitate scheduling meetings and coordinate across multiple stakeholders to maintain alignment on milestones and deliverables.
* Monitor progress and flag potential schedule risks, bottlenecks, or delays early.
* Ensure all schedules comply with contractual obligations, project goals, and client expectations.
* Support earned value analysis, productivity tracking, and reporting requirements.
* Participate in project closeout by documenting final schedules, lessons learned, and performance metrics.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field; or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of experience in construction scheduling, with at least 2 years on data ce

The money

17% of gross profit margin on every job you sell, plus a $60 bonus per sign-up. No cap.

You get paid on what you sell. That is the whole model.

Who we are

111 Construction. Delivered with integrity.

We are a residential construction company built around roofing, and we handle whatever the house needs after that. Siding, gutters, remodels, additions. Quality work, honest pricing, and we treat a homeowner's property like it is our own.

We are opening in Dyersburg and building the sales team now.

You run your own territory. You knock, you inspect, you document, you sit down with the homeowner, and you close. Then you stay with that customer until the job is finished right.

Find work in your territory through canvassing, referrals, and the leads we generate

Get on roofs and document what you find with photos and measurements

Explain the damage to homeowners in plain language

Write clean, accurate contracts so production is not fixing your math

Keep your CRM current

Follow up, then follow up again

A valid driver's license and a vehicle you can count on

Comfortable on a ladder and on a roof

Able to run your own schedule without anybody checking on you

Straight with people. No pressure tactics, no overselling.

Paid training and ongoing coaching. If you are green, we will teach you.

Company-generated leads on top of what you bring in

Uniforms, marketing material, sales tools, and a CRM that works

Branding that opens doors

Flexible schedule

Room to move up as we grow

You'll handle scopes of work, change orders, and billing with precision, thriving in a fast-paced environment where your contributions directly impact our success.

* Confirm filter and belt lists on maintenance work orders match the service agreement

headlined_rolled.title: Estimator / Project Manager (Heavy Civil)
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Description**

Marwood General Construction is a Service Disabled Veteran Owned heavy civil contractor working federal, municipal, and private civil projects across Kitsap and the surrounding counties. We self perform our work. Earthwork, utilities, structures, paving, site clearing, concrete flatwork, demolition, and hauling. We own our iron and we run our own dirt.

Our market runs in three lanes. Federal work through NAVFAC and Naval Base Kitsap is a growing part of our pipeline. Municipal and public agency work is steady. Private commercial site development rounds it out. We are also OMWBE certified and a participant in the WSDOT Capacity Building Mentorship Program.

This position is a dual hat seat with real ownership. You take a job from bid invitation through award, then carry that same job through buyout, execution, and closeout. You are accountable for the margin you wrote into it.

That structure is deliberate. Estimators who never build their own work develop expensive blind spots. We want someone who has to live with their numbers, because that is what makes a number honest.

A lot of our people are veterans, and it shows in how we run. We hire self starters who can move without direct supervision, make a sound call, own the outcome, and tell us straight what happened. We are small enough that this hire will visibly move the company, and established enough that the work is already there. You will not be a cog in an estimating department. You will build it.

Duties

**Estimating**

* Own bids end to end. ITB review, site visit, quantity takeoff, unit pricing, subcontractor and vendor solicitation, bid day close, and closeout feedback back into the cost library.
* Price earthwork, utilities, structures, and paving for federal, municipal, and private civil work in the $500K to $10M range.
* Build production rate based pricing from crew composition, equipment fleet cost, and realistic daily output. Not gut feel and not a marked up unit price book.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Project Coordinator supports locations across the Endurant Disaster Recovery network, keeping restoration and reconstruction jobs organized, documented, and moving from estimate approval through final payment. This role manages job setup, contracts, invoicing, third-party administrator (TPA) compliance, and job status reporting under the direction of the Project Coordinator Manager, in partnership with location Estimators, Project Managers, and the VP of Construction.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing multiple jobs, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. This person serves as a key link between corporate, field operations, estimating, customers, carriers, and trade partners, and helps bring consistent coordination practices to every location.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**Job Setup and Documentation**

* Enter and maintain accurate job information, project dates, and weekly progress notes in the job management systems (RM, PSA) and corresponding TPA platforms
* Confirm jobs are approved for production and that all claim information, including the deductible, has been collected
* Collect and file required job documents, including authorizations to repair (ATRs), contracts, change orders, certificates of completion (COCs), TPA-required documents, and lien waivers
* Send work authorizations, contracts, change orders, and punch lists to customers through DocuSign, and track signatures to completion
* Request EagleView reports and other supporting documentation as needed
* Compile and file the completed supervisor estimate and supporting paperwork at job close

**Contracts, Budgeting, and Scheduling**

* Import estimates into PSA when needed and review work orders and job budgets against compa

headlined_rolled.title: Office Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
### **Ace Handyman Services**

Are you tired of **cold-calling and chasing customers who aren't interested?** Have experience in sales, booking appointments, or closing jobs over the phone?

Ace Handyman Services is looking for an **Office Manager** who is organized, outgoing, and comfortable turning incoming customer calls into booked jobs.

What You'll Do

* Answer incoming calls and respond to customer inquiries
* Talk with homeowners about their handyman needs
* Book jobs and close sales over the phone
* Schedule and coordinate jobs with our craftsmen
* Follow up with customers and leads
* Manage the office calendar and customer information
* Provide excellent customer service
* Help keep the day-to-day office running smoothly

We're Looking For Someone Who

* Has sales, appointment-setting, or phone-based booking experience
* Lives within 20 miles of Little Rock
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with management and the team
* Enjoys talking to customers and solving problems
* Is organized and detail-oriented
* Can multitask in a fast-paced environment
* Is dependable, professional, and motivated
* Willing to learn new skills and take initiative as the company grows

Pay & Schedule

**$17–$20 per hour, based on experience.**

The position includes a 90-day probationary period, followed by a performance review and opportunity for a pay increase based on performance.

**Required Schedule:** Monday-Friday from 8:00AM to 5:00PM

**The best part? You're not cold-calling random people. Customers are already reaching out because they need work done. Your job is to understand what they need, help them, and get the job booked.**

If you're a salesperson looking to get off the cold-call treadmill and into a rewarding home-service business, we'd love to hear from you!

**Apply today!**

headlined_rolled.desc:
Ace Handyman Services Southern Maryland is a locally owned franchise of Ace Handyman Services, one of the largest residential repair and maintenance networks in the country. We’re opening in November 2026 and building the team that will make our customers’ first call the best experience they’ve had with a home service company. The office is the heart of that experience, and we’re looking for someone to run it.

**What you’ll do**

* Answer and manage inbound calls, web requests, and emails with a friendly, professional, and organized approach

* Maintain office supplies, vendor relationships, and basic administrative records

**What we’re looking for**

* Previous office, dispatch, customer service, or scheduling experience. Field service or home services experience is a strong plus.

* Excellent phone manner and written communication
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle several priorities without dropping any
* Calm, solution-oriented under pressure, especially when a schedule changes at 7 a.m.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Reliable transportation and a dependable schedule

**Why this role**

* Be part of a launch: help build the systems, processes, and customer experience from day one
* Work alongside owners who are hands-on in daily operations
* Competitive

headlined_rolled.desc:
You are the organized force that keeps a local business humming. You don’t just “answer phones”—you are the first impression of a high-end service brand and the tactical coordinator who ensures our field crews are exactly where they need to be. If you have a knack for turning a ringing phone into a scheduled appointment and a pile of receipts into a clean set of books, you belong at the center of our operations in Aptos.

**About Adney Tree Service**

Based right here in Aptos, CA, **Adney Tree Service** is a premier provider of professional tree care. We serve the greater Santa Cruz County area with a focus on safety, precision, and elite customer service. Unlike “splash and dash” outfits, we’ve built our reputation on community trust and deep expertise in professional arboriculture. We are a local team that values stability, clear communication, and professional pride.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Office Manager is the heartbeat of our growth. By managing the flow of inbound leads and keeping our financial records organized, you allow our arborists to focus on the canopy while you handle the core. Your efficiency in scheduling and bookkeeping directly impacts our ability to serve the Aptos community and scale our operations effectively.

* **Hourly Range:** $30-50 dollars per hour (commensurate with experience)
* **Schedule:** 40 hours per week.
* **Performance Incentives:** Eligible for bonuses based on lead conversion accuracy and organizational milestones.

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) works with a Project Manager in running the day-to-day project management operations on a project.

**GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES**
============================

* **Project Set Up:** Set proper tools in place prior to the beginning of a project, collaborating with project team to ensure profitability and client satisfaction. (General conditions, buy schedule and strategy, etc.)

* **Safety:** Serves in a support role to organize, direct, and control the implementation of the project Safety Plan that meets the goal of zero workplace injuries and zero OSHA citations for the entire project duration.
* **Financial Management:** Ensure that jobs are set up properly to meet established profit goals by analyzing and integrating all business and contractual terms.
* **Relationship Management:** Develop critical relationships with client, design team, field team, subcontractors, and vendors.

* Bachelor's degree in applicable discipline
* 3 years of related experience in construction industry preferred
* Ability to manage, embrace change, respond, and adapt

ARG Construction is seeking a detail-oriented, strategic **Purchasing Manager** to oversee procurement operations across all project phases. This role plays a vital part in company strategy, cost optimization, vendor relations, and cross-departmental coordination from project development through production.

Key Responsibilities

* Procurement & Operations: Analyze, negotiate, and implement purchasing processes and delivery systems. Issue Purchase Orders (POs) and maintain an up-to-date PO Log.

* Compliance & Documentation: Request and manage W-9 forms, Certificates of Insurance (GL, Builders Risk), performance bonds, and submittals. Oversee and audit Subcontractor Certified Payroll throughout project lifecycles.
* Project Site Logistics: Coordinate project startups with Project Managers, including 811 calls and establishing site utilities, temporary facilities, storage, and site protection.
* Asset & Inventory Control: Manage company assets (tools, equipment, fleet vehicles), including maintenance logs, fuel card allocations, and corporate electronics.
* Financial & Administrative Support: Track material price increases, perform cost comparison analyses, manage corporate credit card allocations, and support HR on employee onboarding/offboarding logistics.

Qualifications & Skills

headlined_rolled.title: Civil Construction Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Position Overview**

Arizona Professional Excavating LLC is seeking an experienced Civil Construction Estimator to join our team. As a Civil Construction Estimator, you will be responsible for preparing complete, accurate, and competitive cost estimates for public and private heavy civil construction projects. You will analyze bid documents, conduct quantity takeoffs, solicit subcontractor quotes, and collaborate with operations teams to develop winning bidding strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Bid Preparation & Takeoffs:** Perform accurate digital quantity takeoffs (dirt work, utilities, concrete, asphalt) from engineering drawings, plans, and specifications.
* **Cost Estimating:** Develop detailed cost estimates including labor, material, equipment, subcontractor quotes, and overhead using construction estimating software.
* **Subcontractor & Supplier Relations:** Build and maintain strong relationships with subcontractors and vendors; prepare bid packages, solicit proposals, and negotiate terms.
* **Site Visits & Risk Assessment:** Attend pre-bid meetings and perform field site visits to evaluate access, soil conditions, utility hazards, and job site risks.
* **Strategy & Review:** Lead estimate review meetings with senior leadership to determine profit margins, contingency, and final bid pricing.
* **Project Handover:** Partner with project managers and superintendents during project handoffs to review baseline budgets, scope of work, and key operational assumptions.

**Qualifications and Skills**

· **Experience:** 2+ years of civil construction estimating experience (heavy highway, earthwork, utilities, or paving preferred).

· **Technical skills:** Proficiency with takeoff software, Microsoft Office programs, Google Sheets, and social media platforms.

· **Professional skills:** Strong problem-solving abilities, excellent organization, and effective time management.

**How to Apply**

To apply, please send your resume to admin@azproex.com.

headlined_rolled.title: Accounting Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
BEI Construction is seeking a temporary Accounting Assistant to support our accounting team through the end of 2026. There may be opportunity for this role to convert to regular full-time classification in 2027. The Accounting Assistant supports accurate and timely accounting operations across both accounts payable and accounts receivable. This role reviews and enters invoices, assists with vendor payments, prepares customer billings, applies incoming payments, maintains organized records, and helps reconcile accounts. This entry-level position is ideal for a detail-oriented individual who is eager to build broad accounting experience in a fast-paced construction environment. This position is based in Alameda, CA and reports to the Controller.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Review vendor invoices for accuracy, proper approval, job-cost coding, and required supporting documentation.
* Match invoices to purchase orders, subcontracts, delivery receipts, and other records.
* Enter accounts payable invoices and payment information accurately and promptly into the accounting system.
* Prepare checks, electronic payments, and supporting payment documentation for review.
* Monitor invoice approval status and follow up with internal teams to help ensure timely payment.
* Reconcile vendor statements, research discrepancies, and resolve routine payment issues.
* Maintain accurate vendor records, including tax forms, lien releases, insurance documents, and payment records.
* Assist with accounts payable aging reviews, month-end close, audits, and other payable-related projects.
* Provide secondary accounts receivable support by preparing customer invoices, progress billings, and related documentation.
* Record and apply customer payments and assist with routine receivable account follow-up.
* Respond professionally to vendor, customer, and internal accounting inquiries.
* Protect confidential financial, customer, vendor, and company information.
* Other duties as assigned.

headlined_rolled.title: Payroll Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
BEI Construction is seeking a hands-on Payroll Manager to lead payroll operations and support the implementation of BEI’s new payroll and timekeeping software. This role is responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, compliance, and continuous improvement of payroll for union and non-union employees. The Payroll Manager supervises the Payroll Specialist and works closely with the Controller and Accounting team on payroll funding, reporting, reconciliations, job costing, audits, and internal controls.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead payroll workstreams for BEI’s payroll/timekeeping software implementation, including configuration support, testing, parallel payroll, data validation, reporting, training, and post-launch stabilization.
* Oversee accurate, timely weekly payroll for union and non-union employees, including regular payroll, off-cycle payroll, adjustments, final pay, deductions, garnishments, reimbursements, and employee changes.
* Supervise and support the Payroll Specialist; assign priorities, review work, resolve escalations, and maintain consistent payroll procedures and controls.
* Partner with the Controller and Accounting team on payroll funding, payroll taxes, job costing, labor allocation, reconciliations, reporting, audits, internal controls, and system-related process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with wage and hour requirements, union rules, prevailing wage, certified payroll, public works requirements, payroll tax rules, recordkeeping, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
* Resolve payroll discrepancies, timekeeping issues, employee pay questions, agency notices, and related payroll inquiries.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of progressive payroll experience, including hands-on payroll management and team leadership.

* Experience with complex payroll environments required; construction, union payroll, prevailing wage, certified payroll, public works, multi-rate, or multi-state payroll experience strongly preferred.

We’re looking for a dependable, hands-on person to work directly with Jake and help keep our residential construction and renovation projects moving.  
This role combines project coordination with physical work on job sites. headlined_rolled.title: Hvac Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Overview**

As an HVAC Estimator, you’ll turn construction plans and project requirements into clear, accurate estimates for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning work. You’ll review drawings, assess material and labor needs, develop project budgets, and support pricing and contract discussions. Your work will help teams plan effectively and give clients a reliable understanding of project costs.

Your impact: Accurate estimates help project teams control costs and help clients make informed decisions.

**Responsibilities**

* Review construction drawings and technical documents to define HVAC scope and estimate material requirements.
* Prepare project budgets, pricing, and cost estimates for commercial and residential construction; support cost management and cost control.
* Use estimating software and spreadsheets to organize takeoffs, assumptions, and estimate details.
* Coordinate with project teams and clients, communicate estimate findings, and support negotiations and contract review.
* Apply construction site experience and construction management knowledge to assess project conditions and manage estimating work.

**Requirements**

* Construction estimating experience, including estimating commercial construction projects and managing projects as a construction estimator.
* Ability to read blueprints, review construction drawings, interpret technical drawings, and estimate material costs and requirements.
* Experience in the construction industry; construction experience is essential, while construction site experience is preferred.

Pay: $25.00 - $40.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Summary**

The Bookkeeper maintains accurate and up-to-date financial records for multiple entities. This includes recording day-to-day financial transactions, reconciling accounts, maintaining clean separation between entities, and supporting the Accounting Manager through month-end close.

Because this role works across multiple related entities and has visibility into ownership-level financial information, discretion and sound judgment are as essential to the job as technical accuracy.

**Core Accountability**

The Bookkeeper is accountable for the accurate, complete, and timely recording of financial transactions in the general ledgers of the companies; for ensuring expenses are coded to the correct entity, account, and job; and for keeping financial records organized, audit-ready, and maintained in accordance with company processes.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Records daily financial transactions, including purchases, receipts, and payments, in the accounting system.
* Maintains the general ledger and posts journal entries as directed.
* Codes invoices and expenses to the correct entity, general ledger account, and job cost code.
* Maintains clean separation between entities and records intercompany transactions and allocations accurately.
* Reconciles bank, credit card, and vendor statements monthly and resolves discrepancies.
* Supports accounts payable and accounts receivable as needed, including entering invoices and applying customer payments.
* Reviews and reconciles employee expense reports and company credit card transactions.
* Maintains vendor records and supports annual 1099 preparation.
* Assists with month-end and year-end close, including preparing supporting schedules and account reconciliations.
* Prepares basic financial reports and account summaries for accounting leadership.
* Assists with internal and external audits by pulling and organizing supporting documentation.

headlined_rolled.title: Restoration Estimator - Xactimate
headlined_rolled.desc:
**About Us**  
Restoration 1 of Huntington Beach is a licensed disaster restoration and environmental remediation company (CA GC #1131316) serving Orange County. We handle water, fire, and mold mitigation and reconstruction, working directly with homeowners, insurance carriers, and adjusters. We're growing and need a sharp estimator who can write accurate, defensible Xactimate estimates that get approved and paid.

**The Role**  
You'll own the estimating process from first inspection to final approval. That means scoping losses on site, building detailed Xactimate estimates for both mitigation and reconstruction, and working with adjusters to get every legitimate line item paid.

**Responsibilities**

* Inspect water, fire, and mold losses and document damage with photos, moisture readings, and measurements
* Create floor plans and sketches in Xactimate Sketch, or using Matterport/DocuSketch
* Write complete, accurate Xactimate estimates for emergency services, mitigation, and reconstruction
* Prepare and submit supplements with supporting documentation
* Communicate and negotiate professionally with insurance adjusters and carrier desk reviewers
* Upload estimates and documentation to carrier and TPA portals (XactAnalysis, Contractor Connection, etc.)
* Review completed job files so final invoices match the work performed
* Coordinate with the field crew and office on scope, materials, and job progress
* Track estimate status, approvals, and receivables

**Job Summary**

The Project Scheduler supports the planning, coordination, and monitoring of construction schedules across multiple projects. This role primarily focuses on assisting with schedule development during the proposal phase and partnering with superintendents and project teams to maintain, update, and improve active project schedules. The Project Scheduler plays a key role in ensuring schedules are realistic, properly maintained, and aligned with project goals and field conditions.

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* Collaborate with superintendents and project managers to update and maintain active project schedules, ensuring alignment with field progress and conditions.
* Identify potential schedule conflicts, delays, or impacts and assist project teams in developing mitigation or recovery plans.
* Facilitate and participate in regular schedule review meetings with project teams.
* Track and monitor key project milestones and schedule performance across multiple projects.

* Provide guidance, direction, and support to field teams on scheduling best practices and use of scheduling tools, especially with regard to difficult project impacts. Assess the impact of design changes and schedule slippages.
* Assist in standardizing scheduling processes, templates, and reporting methods across projects.

Burrow Global is seeking an experienced **Construction Planner / Scheduler** for a 4-month field assignment in Beaumont, TX. This role will support the execution of a new petrochemical process facility project. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and updating the master project schedule using **Primavera P6 and MS Project** tracking field progress, analyzing critical paths, and coordinating with site execution, engineering, and procurement teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Schedule Development & Maintenance:** Maintain and baseline the Primavera P6 CPM (Critical Path Method) schedule, including detailed construction, engineering, procurement, and commissioning activities for the terminal process facility.
* **Progress Tracking & Analysis:** Perform weekly site walkthroughs to audit and update physical field progress against baseline targets.
* **Critical Path & Variance Analysis:** Identify potential schedule slippages, analyze critical and sub-critical paths, and recommend mitigation strategies or recovery schedules.
* **Petrochemical / Terminal Integration:** Align scheduling logic with site-specific sequence requirements, including civil works, structural steel, piping fabrication/erection, heavy lift operations, electrical & instrumentation (E&I), and tie-ins.
* **Resource & Workface Management:** Monitor equipment, labor histogram, and productivity metrics; support Look-Ahead schedules (1-week, 2-week, and 3-week) with site superintendents and subcontractors.
* **Reporting & Stakeholder Communication:** Produce weekly/monthly progress reports, S-curves, man-hour curves, and milestone variance reports for project leadership and client representatives.
* **Management of Change (MOC):** Evaluate the schedule impact of field change orders, requests for information (RFIs), and scope modifications.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**JOB TITLE:**

Commercial Sales Representative

**REPORTS TO:**

Director of Sales

**STATUS:**

Activate

**REVISION DATE:**

10/7/2026

**SUMMARY OF JOB PURPOSE:**

Butte Fence is seeking a Commercial Sales Representative to develop and maintain relationships with commercial customers and generate profitable commercial fence sales. This position is responsible for identifying opportunities, reviewing plans and specifications, preparing accurate estimates and proposals, following up on bids, and helping ensure a smooth handoff of sold projects to Operations.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop and maintain relationships with general contractors, developers, property managers, and other commercial customers.
* Review plans, specifications, bid invitations, and jobsite conditions to prepare accurate and timely estimates.
* Prepare clear and profitable proposals that identify scope, pricing, exclusions, assumptions, and project requirements.
* Achieve established sales and gross margin goals.
* Follow up consistently on bids and opportunities and maintain an accurate sales pipeline.
* Negotiate pricing and scope while protecting company profitability and customer relationships.
* Maintain strong knowledge of fencing products, installation methods, and commercial project requirements.

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Company:** Carter Electric, LLC

**Position:** Construction Accounting Assistant

**Reports to:** Controller

**Position Summary**

The Construction Accounting Assistant supports the Accounting and Operations teams by managing construction-related accounting functions, including accounts receivable, progress billing, lien compliance, Notice to Owner (NTO) tracking, contract administration, and job cost reporting. This position requires experience in the construction industry and proficiency with Sage 100 Contractor. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Accounts Receivable & Billing**

* Prepare and process progress billings, pay applications, and customer invoices.
* Review contract documents to ensure billing complies with contract terms.
* Monitor collections and follow up on outstanding customer balances.
* Apply customer payments and maintain accurate aging reports.
* Assist with monthly billing reconciliations and revenue tracking.
* Support month-end and year-end closing activities.

**Construction Contracts & Compliance**

* Prepare, track, and maintain Notice to Owner (NTO) documentation.
* Manage lien waiver collections from vendors and subcontractors.
* Monitor lien rights and filing deadlines.
* Assist with preparation and tracking of liens, releases, and related documentation.
* Maintain compliance files for subcontractors, including Certificates of Insurance (COIs), W-9s, and licensing requirements.
* Coordinate with project managers and customers to resolve contract and billing issues.

**Job Cost Accounting**

* Assist with job setup and maintenance in Sage 100 Contractor.
* Review job costs for accuracy and proper coding.
* Support project managers by providing job cost reports and financial information.
* Analyze billing versus cost-to-date on active construction projects.
* Assist with change order track

headlined_rolled.title: Office Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
Case Construction has served Central New York for over 40 years, providing excavation, remodeling, new construction, and commercial services. We’re looking for an organized, dependable Office Manager to keep our daily office operations running smoothly and support our customers, management team, and field crews.

**What you’ll do:**

* Manage daily office operations, phone calls, emails, and customer inquiries.
* Coordinate appointments, schedules, and communication between customers, subcontractors, suppliers, and crews.
* Prepare and organize estimates, contracts, invoices, and project paperwork.
* Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payment tracking.
* Collect and organize employee time records and assist with payroll preparation.
* Maintain accurate job files, vendor records, and office supplies.
* Follow up on outstanding paperwork and help keep projects moving.

**What we’re looking for:**

* Experience in office management, administrative support, or a similar role.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Friendly, professional communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a busy construction office.
* Comfort using Microsoft Office and learning business software.
* Discretion when handling employee, customer, and financial information.
* Construction industry experience preferred.

**Benefits:**

* Paid holidays.
* Accrued paid time off.
* Insurance benefits available.
* IRA retirement plan.

**Why Case Construction?**

You’ll play an important role in an established local company built on hard work, quality craftsmanship, and integrity. We’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work, solves problems, and enjoys helping a team succeed.

Pay: $20.00 - $27.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.title: AI Construction Scheduler
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Overview**

As an AI Construction Scheduler, you’ll combine construction knowledge, project scheduling, and data analysis to build and maintain reliable project schedules. You’ll use artificial intelligence (AI) tools alongside construction management software to organize project information, identify schedule risks, and support timely decisions. Your work will help project teams coordinate plans, resources, and deadlines across civil construction projects.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, update, and analyze construction schedules using Primavera P6 and other scheduling software.
* Apply AI tools and project data to identify potential delays, dependencies, and schedule conflicts; validate findings against construction plans and site conditions.
* Coordinate with project managers, estimators, and field teams to align schedules with construction estimating, contracts, costs, and project plans.
* Maintain schedule and project records in construction management software, including Procore, Bluebeam, Prolog, and HeavyBid, as applicable.
* Your impact: Clear, accurate schedules help project teams anticipate constraints and coordinate work so field crews and project stakeholders can make informed decisions.

**Qualifications**

* **8-12+ years** as a construction project manager
* Experience at a general contractor, ideally a top 100-200 US GC (e.g., DPR, Turner, Gilbane, Whiting-Turner, Suffolk)
* Track record managing multiple complex projects across the US, covering both planning and execution, either managing projects directly or managing the PMs who run them
* Ability to read and understand blueprints and construction drawings
* Working knowledge of 4D scheduling software, construction project management tools, and 3D modeling/BIM software (**essential**)

Pay: $140,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA (San Francisco County)

CONNORS PLUMBING & HEATING

Connors Plumbing, Heating & Air is a residential service company specializing in Plumbing, Heating & Air and has been in business for over 75 years. As a Dispatcher, you'll be the one who keeps everything moving, coordinating technicians and

* Serve as the main point of contact for technicians throughout the day
* Keep accurate records of completed jobs, reschedules, and customer feedback

Licenses/Certifications  

* Valid driver's license with clean driving record preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities  

* Strong communication and multitasking skills
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
* Organized with strong attention to detail

headlined_rolled.title: Payroll Specialist
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Payroll Specialist**

We are a fast-paced, busy construction company. The multi-tasking and efficiency is a must.

Essential Job Functions:  
The Payroll Specialist is responsible for the maintenance and proper execution of Certified and hourly payroll. Our payroll specialist is required to

* Manage payroll functions including: timecard processing, benefits administration, and timekeeping.
* Perform timekeeping duties such as: Timekeeping accountability, Timekeeping reports, Timecard reconciliation, Timecard maintenance, Timekeeping audits and compliance.
* Assist with the preparation of monthly payroll reports.
* Ensure prevailing wage jobs are compliant with the Department of Industry Relations.
* Provide Certified Payroll Reports to DIR and General Contractors.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

* High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Payroll role.
* Knowledge in timekeeping, payroll functions, and Quickbooks required.
* Prevailing Wage time-keeping required.

Benefits:  
We offer comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, 401k retirement plan with matching contributions. We also provide paid holidays.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

Physical Setting:

* Office

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* Payroll: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.title: Bookkeeper
headlined_rolled.desc:
The Walsh organization is looking for a bookkeeper to join our team.

Job Description:

* Assist with daily bookkeeping requirements for multiple organizations
* Balance and maintain accurate ledgers
* Perform payroll on a weekly basis for multiple companies
* Match purchase orders with invoices
* Coordinate bank deposits and report financial results on a regular basis to management
* Monitor office expenses and tally and enter cash receipts
* Pay vendor invoices and track bank account balances
* Develop monthly financial statements, including cash flow, profit and loss statements and balance sheets
* Prepare quarterly and monthly tax returns, along with payroll, operating and business taxes

Qualifications:

* Five years experience working in accounts payable and receivable, general ledger, payroll and payroll reports
* Strong knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles
* Extensive experience with data entry, record keeping and computer operation
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel and QuickBooks
* Experience in services related to payroll such as writing checks and submitting payroll taxes
* Strong understanding of business and income tax worksheets and computation
* Obtain necessary tax forms from new vendors
* Perform reconciliations of bank accounts on a monthly basis to ensure accuracy
* Make deposits and record all cash receipts
* Ensure receivables are collected in a timely manner
* Provide administrative support to management when required

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.title: Account Manager - Luxury Residential Landscape Maintenance
headlined_rolled.desc:
For more than 30 years, Arizona Outdoor Designs has been a trusted partner to high‑net‑worth residential clients, designers, and general contractors—creating exceptional outdoor environments through craftsmanship, precision, and reliability. As we continue to scale our platform through organic growth and acquisitions, we are building the infrastructure, systems, and leadership required to support a best‑in‑class field organization.

We are currently searching for an Account Manager to join our Landscape Maintenance team with a typical territory of the Cave Creek, AZ area.

As an Account Manager, you will oversee daily operations across our prestigious sites and will be responsible for managing a designated territory where you will ensure the delivery of high-quality service to clients. You will also maintain strong client and employee retention, driving workplace safety, and crew productivity.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develop and nurture long-term relationships with an assigned portfolio of high-end clients, offering discrete partnership and professional communications regarding their unique properties.
* Visit sites regularly to ensure crews are working safely, assess quality, and identify areas for enhancements (which may include trimming, seasonal color, pest or disease treatment, or other specialized services).
* Partner with field supervisors and foremen to review and implement efficient work schedules that do not hinder customer schedules, while maintaining excellent service standards.
* Identify tasks and upgrades that will enhance the assigned property’s appeal and value; draft and present detailed proposals for additional services.
* Lead teams to uphold the highest standards of craftsmanship and service, coordinating with vendors and contractors to ensure timely delivery of services.
* Report to senior management with regular updates on client satisfaction, operational efficiency, and performance metrics.

CMP is looking for a dependable, organized, and customer-focused Concrete Pump Dispatcher to join our team. headlined_rolled.desc:
**Construction Scheduler Job Description:**

The Construction Scheduler will work closely with the Project Management, Construction, and Management team, to maintain schedules during project development and report accurate schedule statuses weekly.

**Responsibilities**

* Update/track development and project-related activities while maintaining close contact with the construction field teams and all supporting home office groups including Operations/Procurement and Preconstruction
* Develop, coordinate and manage Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project schedules weekly
* Prepare detailed schedule reports as required including critical path view, baseline vs. actual view, look ahead and milestone view
* Review weekly and monthly lower tier subcontractor reports
* Maintain and track the schedules for the various phases of project development and construction while coordinating milestones, resources and project schedules
* Assisting and identifying critical path areas and ability to help develop recovery plans
* All other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* Experience with Primavera 6 required
* 5 years experience with construction scheduling, natural resource construction, and RNG preferred
* Strong leadership, written and oral communication, and interpersonal skills
* Hybrid position that may require up to 75% travel

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
***Engage Contracting*** is looking for an ***Construction Estimator*** to join our team!

This Estimator will be responsible for building project bid packages, contacting subcontractors, managing project files to prepare cost and labor estimates for bids/proposals. The ideal candidate will have 5-7 years of commercial estimating, strong interpersonal communication skills, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of construction management.

* Independently prepare estimates for assigned scopes and smaller projects.
* Review construction documents, bid requirements, and specifications for completeness and scope applicability.
* Develop detailed trade scopes and coordinate subcontractor outreach.
* Perform quantity takeoffs using digital and traditional methods.
* Solicit, receive, and level subcontractor and supplier proposals.
* Identify scope gaps, overlaps, design conflicts, and constructability concerns.
* Prepare bid recaps, clarifications, assumptions, and proposal qualifications.
* Participate in scope review meetings and estimate review meetings.
* Assist with conceptual budgeting and value engineering exercises.
* Develop pricing using historical data, market input, and subcontractor feedback.
* Support risk review and pricing strategy discussions with department leadership.
* Prepare and assemble bid submission documents accurately and on time.
* Assist with project handoff to operations, including scope review and estimate turnover.
* Maintain accurate cost history and estimating database information.
* Mentor Junior Estimators and Estimator I team members on assigned tasks.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.title: Accounting Admin
headlined_rolled.desc:
English Construction is seeking a detail-oriented and organized **Accounting Admin** to join our Accounting Department. This position plays a critical role in managing vendor setup, processing invoices, and handling check runs. The ideal candidate will be proactive, accurate, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

This position provides essential accounting and administrative support to the company’s accounting team. This role is responsible for processing subcontractor invoices and day-to-day accounting operations.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail oriented, dependable, and has experience working with accounting software and Microsoft Office.

Essential Job Tasks, Duties, and Responsibilities

· Review, enter, and remit payment for approved subcontractor invoices.

· Monitor subcontractor insurance compliance.

· Reconcile subcontractor statements and DOT estimates, address discrepancies, and promptly respond to subcontractor inquiries.

· Review and follow up on outstanding checks, assisting with resolving aged or uncashed checks.

· Handle switchboard duties, including answering calls and preparing shipping labels.

· Process and maintain accounting information efficiently and accurately using Sage Timberline, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Outlook.

· Assist with financial audits and provide supporting documentation as requested.

· Crosstrain with other accounting team members and provide backup support as needed.

· Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Skills

· Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

· Excellent organizational and time management skills.

· Ability to handle confidential financial information.

· Strong communication and follow up skills.

· Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Outlook.

· Experience with Sage Timberline or similar accounting software preferred.

· Previous accounts payable or accounting

headlined_rolled.title: Preconstruction Administrative Specialist
headlined_rolled.desc:
The Preconstruction Estimating Department Administrative Specialist provides administrative, document control, and bid coordination support to Enterprise Electrical’s Preconstruction and Estimating team. This role organizes project information, tracks pursuit deadlines and submission requirements, coordinates vendor and subcontractor communications, and prepares proposal materials so estimators can develop accurate bids using current and complete information. The position supports the process from receipt of a bid invitation through proposal submission, bid follow-up, and transfer of awarded-project records.

Working under the direction of the Preconstruction Director or Chief Estimator, this position manages multiple administrative assignments with attention to accuracy, confidentiality, and follow-through. The Administrative Specialist anticipates missing information, communicates deadline risks, and adapts quickly as priorities change in a growing electrical construction business. Estimators retain responsibility for technical scope, quantities, labor assumptions, pricing decisions, and final estimate approval.

**Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities**

Tasks may include, but are not limited to the following:

* Maintain the bid calendar, recording due dates, pre-bid meetings, site visits, review milestones, and customer submission requirements.

* Create project folders and maintain consistent naming, file organization, permissions, and document version control.

* Download, organize, and distribute drawings, specifications, addenda, bid forms, and customer instructions to the appropriate team members.

* Track document revisions and notify estimators of new addenda, changed deadlines, or updated submission requirements.

* Prepare and distribute invitations to bid using scope information and recipient lists approved by estimators.

* Maintain vendor and subcontractor contact information, bid lists, quotation logs, and records of follow-up activity.

headlined_rolled.title: Assistant Project Manager - ATX
headlined_rolled.desc:
The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the successful execution of electrical construction projects by assisting in planning, coordination, and day-to-day project management activities. This role works closely with Project Managers, field leadership, vendors, and internal teams to help ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with company standards. The APM plays a key role in managing documentation, tracking project performance, supporting procurement and financial processes, and facilitating communication across all phases of the project lifecycle.

**Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities**

**T**asks may include, but are not limited to the following:

* Assist the PM in managing day-to-day project operations and administrative tasks.

* Support the preparation, review, and tracking of RFIs, submittals, change orders, and project logs.

* Help organize weekly project schedules, manpower plans, material deliveries, and long-lead tracking.

* Attend project meetings (internal and external) and prepare meeting notes or action items.

* Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure timely distribution of updates to stakeholders.

* Conduct periodic site walks with the PM or Superintendent to observe progress and verify installation compliance.

* Assist with documenting field conditions, tracking percent of completion, and reporting potential delays.

* Coordinate with field leadership to ensure alignment on project goals, safety standards, and execution plans.

* Assist in monitoring labor hours, equipment usage, and material costs.

* Review purchase orders, delivery tickets, and subcontractor invoices for accuracy.

* Help prepare weekly project summaries and cost-to-complete updates for leadership.

* Support communication between clients, general contractors, engineers, and Enterprise Electrical teams.

* Maintain professionalism when interacting with external partners while representing Enterprise

**Job Description**
-------------------

The MEPFP Systems Estimator will prepare estimates for MEPFP trades (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection), working with the estimating team, architects, and clients to ensure accuracy and budget alignment. They will work on projects at all phases of design across all sectors of the business.

Seeking an experienced **HVAC Estimator / Takeoff Specialist** to assist with estimating commercial, multifamily, and residential HVAC projects.

The ideal candidate must be able to independently review construction drawings, mechanical plans, specifications, and project documents to prepare accurate HVAC material and equipment takeoffs for bidding purposes.

**Responsibilities**

* Review mechanical/HVAC plans, architectural drawings, specifications, and project documents.
* Perform detailed HVAC takeoffs from construction drawings.

* Perform ductwork takeoffs, including sheet metal duct, flexible duct, fittings, dampers, registers, grilles, diffusers, and louvers.
* Perform refrigeration piping, condensate piping, insulation, controls, and related HVAC accessory takeoffs.
* Review project plans for scope requirements and potential discrepancies.
* Identify items that may require RFIs or clarification before bidding.
* Obtain and review vendor/subcontractor pricing when required.
* Prepare organized bid worksheets and cost breakdowns.
* Coordinate with management to ensure the complete HVAC scope is captured before submitting a proposal.
* Review addendums and plan revisions and update estimates accordingly.
* Maintain organized estimating records for current and upcoming projects.

**Qualifications**

* Previous HVAC estimating and/or HVAC takeoff experience required.
* Strong understanding of HVAC construction drawings and mechanical plans.
* Knowledge of ductwork, HVAC equipment, ventilation systems, refrigeration piping, controls, and related materials.
* Ability to accurately read plans, schedules, details, and specifications.
* Experience with HVAC takeoff/estimating software is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skil
