**Job description**

**Sales Representative — Florida**

Florida Roofing and Gutters is looking for a driven, competitive **Sales Representative** to join our growing Florida team.

This role is for someone who wants to **build a strong book of business, earn at a high level, and take ownership of their results.**

We aren't looking for someone who needs to be constantly managed or motivated. We're looking for INSPIRED people who want to do great things and be a part of a winning team and who are willing to learn the process, get in the field, talk to homeowners, follow up consistently, and do what it takes to close business.

The right person will be responsible for the **full sales process**, from generating opportunities and inspecting properties to earning the customer's trust, closing the deal, and helping move the job successfully through the process.

**Position Overview**

This is a **field-based sales position** for someone who is comfortable creating opportunities, meeting with homeowners, inspecting properties, and guiding customers through the roofing and exterior restoration process.

You will be expected to take ownership of your pipeline and your results.

That means prospecting when you need more opportunities, following up when a customer isn't ready to make a decision, keeping your CRM updated, and consistently moving deals forward.

Your income and growth within the company will be directly connected to your ability to produce.

**Sales Representative Responsibilities**

* Run company provided leads and produce new sales opportunities, referrals, networking, prospecting, and other lead-generation activities
* Respond to and follow up with leads quickly and consistently
* Meet with homeowners to assess roofing and exterior needs

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Estimator and a person who can procure to own the pricing and quoting process for our hospitality-focused electrical distribution business. This is not a generalist support role — it is a dedicated position for someone who can build accurate, competitive estimates from the ground up and develop real purchasing leverage with our manufacturers and vendor partners over time.

You will work closely with our sales team on quotes for new construction and renovation projects with hotel owners, developers, ECs, and GCs — often on tight timelines where the difference between winning and losing the job comes down to how sharp and defensible our first number is.

* “Partner with manufacturers and vendors to understand pricing structures and negotiate more competitive, consistent upfront costs, minimizing reactive rebids.”
* Develop and grow direct purchasing relationships with manufacturers over time — negotiating volume pricing, program pricing, and preferred-distributor status where possible.
* Investigate and explain pricing discrepancies between initial quotes and rebids, and flag systemic issues (margin erosion, inconsistent vendor pricing, ) to sales leadership.
* Track win/loss ratios on bids and identify where we are losing competitiveness, especially on gear as the entry point to HVAC and commodity business.

headlined_rolled.title: Sewer Sales Project Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
**GENZ RYAN IS HIRING!**

**Sewer Sales Rep & Project Owner: Sell It. Run It. Finish It.**

Most sewer sales jobs end at the signature. Yours starts there.

At Genz-Ryan, you're the homeowner's go-to from the first camera drop to the final restoration. You find the problem, show them the footage, present honest options, close the deal, and then own the project all the way to the finish line. One rep, one point of contact, zero handoff headaches.

**Our culture**

We're hungry, humble, and smart. We give straight feedback, laugh a lot, and live by our core values: Pride, Drive, Team Player, Respect, and Get Sh!t Done. Honesty is how we sell.

**What you'll do**

* **Diagnose.** Run in-home consultations, camera inspections, and line locates to find roots, bellies, offsets, cracks, and collapses in clay, cast iron, and Orangeburg pipe.
* **Prove it.** Every recommendation is backed by video. No footage, no sale.
* **Sell it.** Present good/better/best options, from cleaning and root treatment to spot repair, open-trench, pipe bursting, and CIPP lining. Offer financing on $8K–$30K+ projects.
* **Run it.** Build airtight proposals, then manage the job from start to finish. That means permits, Gopher State One Call locates, crew scheduling, I/I and point-of-sale requirements, and keeping the homeowner in the loop at every step.
* **Finish it.** Make sure restoration is done right and the customer is thrilled enough to leave a review.

  
**Requirements**  

* **2+ years of in-home sales experience in sewer, plumbing, HVAC, or home services required**
* **Must have a valid driver's license**
* Close high-ticket work by building trust, not pressure
* Love keeping a dozen moving pieces organized and on schedule
* Can explain underground problems in plain English
* Don't mind crawl spaces, basements, Minnesota winters, or a little sewage (PPE provided)
* Have a valid driver's license and are comfortable with tablets and field software
* Bonus: trenchless experience or a plum

headlined_rolled.title: Preconstruction Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
***NOW HIRING: EXPERIENCED ESTIMATOR*** - Heavy Civil / Site Development | Atlanta, GA | Full-Time

Department: Estimating & Preconstruction | Company: ***100% Employee-Owned ESOP***

**About the Company**

For 20+ years, Georgia Development Partners has delivered premier heavy civil and site development work across metro Atlanta. As a 100% employee-owned company, our team members share directly in our success while building high-quality projects with lasting community impact.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled Estimator to lead site development bids from plan review through final submission. This role manages grading, excavation, earthwork, utilities, and flat work estimates while partnering with leadership to identify risk, improve profitability, and win key regional work.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead Bids: Manage complete proposals from takeoff to final package submission.
* Prepare Takeoffs: Assess accurate grading, earthwork, utility, and flat work quantities.
* Models: Build detailed dirt models using AGTEK for accurate earthwork quantity calculations.
* Develop Pricing: Substantiate production rates, labor needs, and equipment allocations.
* Coordinate Vendors: Solicit, compare, and negotiate subcontractor and supplier quotes.
* Value Engineer: Review plans, soils reports, and project risks to identify savings.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 5–10 years estimating heavy civil and full site development projects.
* Education: Civil Engineering or Construction Management degree preferred; equivalent field experience considered.

**Required Skills**

* Software: Strong proficiency with AGTEK, HCSS HeavyBid, OST and related takeoff/estimating tools.
* Market knowledge: Atlanta-area subcontractors, suppliers, and municipal civil codes a plus.

**Compensation Package -** Because we are employee-owned, your base salary rewards the impact you make today, while your ESOP shares secure your tomorrow.

* Competitive Annual Base Salary + performance

headlined_rolled.title: Bookkeeper/Administrative Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Position Summary:**

Gornall Construction, Inc. is seeking a dependable and organized **Receptionist/bookkeeper / Office Assistant** to support daily operations in our front office. This individual will be the first point of contact for clients and vendors, and will provide administrative support across multiple areas of the business, including scheduling, bookkeeping, and document management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Answer and direct incoming phone calls** in a professional and courteous manner
* **Greet and assist visitors** at the front desk
* **Scan, upload, and file receipts**, invoices, and other documents into digital systems
* **Schedule appointments and job site visits** for office staff and field supervisors
* **Send and receive invoices and payments** **using QuickBooks** or similar accounting software
* **Support the office team** with clerical tasks, data entry, and communication
* **Manage incoming and outgoing mail**, email, and deliveries
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems
* Assist with supply orders, printing, and occasional errands

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED
* 2 years of quickbooks experience
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Comfortable learning basic accounting or invoicing software (QuickBooks )
* Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask
* Professional appearance and phone etiquette

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive hourly wage based on experience
* Paid holidays after 6 months
* One week vacation after 1 year, two weeks after 3 years
* 401k match after 1 year
* Friendly and professional office environment

Pay: $17.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

Experience:

* QuickBooks: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

They are responsible for defining the project’s objectives by planning, executing, and finalizing projects according to the schedule while keeping within the budget.

DETAILED JOB DESCRIPTION:

Helix Electric was founded in 1985 and is now one of the nation’s largest and most successful electrical contracting companies. Our commitment to empowering people and powering projects is realized by our exceptional team of dedicated and highly skilled experts working together and never settling for good enough. We are proud of the team-oriented and employee-empowered business approach that defines our unique character.

DUTIES AND DESCRIPTION OF SCOPE:

* Close support of senior project management team.
* Develop project teams while delivering quality output, meeting customer expectations, managing to scope, delivering on time, and delivering within budget.
* Develop and support project management techniques and schedule goals, procurement and contractual requirements, personnel assignments, and capacity planning.
* Evaluate and continually improve the systems and processes used by the department to effectively meet customer requirements and profitability goals with an emphasis on strong internal unit tracking methods.
* Ensure schedule requirements are met. Readily adjust priorities and milestones based upon changing customer needs, resource availability, and job requirements.
* Interact with the customer to validate expectations are understood and met before, during, and after project completion.
* Provide close support and oversight for third-party construction firms and subcontractors.
* Manage project review process with particular emphasis on financial forecasting.
* Ensure high-quality engineering, studies, and Helix project delivery.
* Proactively and systematically communicate challenges, risks, and successes.

headlined_rolled.title: Office Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Office Manager – Horizon Excavation**

**Branson, MO | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.**

Horizon Excavation is looking for an experienced **Office Manager** to oversee the administrative and financial needs of our excavation and site work business. This position handles payroll, AP/AR, invoicing, job costing, lien waivers, and general office operations while supporting our project managers and field crews.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Process weekly payroll and code labor to jobs/cost codes.
* Manage accounts payable, vendor invoices, W-9s, and 1099 documentation.
* Prepare customer invoices, progress billings, and AIA pay applications.
* Track receivables, retainage, change orders, and past-due accounts.
* Prepare and track lien waivers for customers, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Maintain job files, contracts, permits, insurance certificates, and DOT/vehicle records.
* Support project managers with job setup, bids, submittals, and paperwork.
* Assist with employee onboarding and personnel records.
* Coordinate documentation with our CPA and insurance provider.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of office management or bookkeeping experience with payroll, AP, and AR.
* Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software.
* Proficient in Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Construction experience preferred, ideally in excavation or general contracting.
* Experience with job costing, AIA billing, retainage, and lien waivers is a plus.

**Pay & Benefits**

* **Pay:** Based on experience
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays

This is an **on-site position in Branson, MO** with occasional trips to local job sites.

**To apply:** Submit your resume along with a brief summary of your relevant experience.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Sourcing Manager, Principal
headlined_rolled.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Skilled trade labor is one of the hardest things to secure on a data center build. This Sourcing Manager owns how Hut 8 finds, qualifies, and contracts the subcontractors that do the work in the field, such as mechanical, electrical, and civil subcontractors, so trade providers show up per the schedule needs, deliver the contracted scope at optimal cost.

The Sourcing Manager works cross-functionally with Construction, Engineering, Finance/AP, Legal, and Operations to lock in subtrade capacity early and minimize commercial and execution risk across capital projects.

Some of the responsibilities you can expect include the following:

* Build a subtrade sourcing plan for each site, including package strategy, target bidders, and a buyout schedule tied to the construction schedule

* Map and prequalify subtrade partners in each market on capacity , safety record (EMR, TRIR, OSHA history), bonding, financial health, manpower, and project history

* Write scope sheets, run competitive bids, and level bids to close scope gaps before award

* Negotiate subcontracts, labor and unit rates, escalation, and manpower commitments, and put program agreements in place with proven partners

* Track trade capacity and competing projects, identifying early risk indicators and escalating before they affect the schedule

* Review change orders, T&M tickets, and claims for merit and price, and keep payments aligned with contractual milestones

* Score subtrade partners after each project and recommend improvements that reduce risk and improve cash flow timing

**ABOUT YOU**

* Bachelor's degree in construction management, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field preferred (equivalent experience considered)

* 5+ years of experience in subcontract buyout, procurement, or contracts management on large capital projects

* Demonstrated experience leveling trade bids and negotiating subcontracts across multiple trade scopes

* Able to read drawings and specifications

headlined_rolled.title: Administrative Assistant & Accounting Coordinator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Overview**

We’re a construction company looking for an Administrative Assistant & Accounting Coordinator to support our office operations and serve as a key point of contact for our clients. You’ll handle client invoicing, accounts receivable, payment follow-up, incoming communications, project documentation, and compliance tracking under the supervision of our Controller.

**Duties**

* Answer phones and triage incoming calls
* Monitor and manage company email communications, respond to routine inquiries, and route messages to the appropriate team member
* Manage client invoicing, accounts receivable, and payment follow-up
* Prepare checks and make bank deposits as needed
* Record and post daily expenses and conduct monthly bank and credit card reconciliations
* Coordinate client and vendor communications and follow up as needed
* Scan and file project documentation, vendor invoices, and compliance records
* Track subcontractor insurance certificates, W-9s, and preliminary notices
* Provide general office and administrative support as needed
* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive company, client, and financial information

**Experience**

* 4+ years of office or accounting experience
* Construction experience is a plus
* Strong customer service and communication skills
* Demonstrated accounting experience, including accounts receivable, expense posting, and reconciliations
* Proficiency with QuickBooks Online (required)
* Familiarity with JobTread (a plus)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Self-motivated and reliable
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, and Word

Pay: $27.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**Pay: $16–$18 per hour, Based on Experience**

IRV HomeServices is seeking an organized, dependable Dispatcher / Warranty Specialist to support our residential plumbing, electrical, and HVAC operations. This position combines technician scheduling, customer service, and warranty claim coordination.

We’re looking for an experienced Scheduler / Dispatcher with strong customer service skills to help keep our busy construction branch running smoothly.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dependable, organized, and customer-focused Support Specialist to help keep our flooring projects and day-to-day operations running smoothly. This position supports customers, sales staff, project managers, and installation crews from the initial inquiry through project completion.

**Responsibilities**

* Answer phones, emails, and customer inquiries in a friendly and professional manner

* Provide general support to sales and management

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and communication skills
* Professional and friendly customer-service approach
* Ability to manage several projects and priorities at once
* Comfortable using email, spreadsheets, scheduling software, and other computer programs
* Attention to detail and strong follow-through
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team

This role balances field inspections, Xactimate writing, carrier communication, supplements, customer updates, and firm deadlines. The Estimator owns the estimating process through approval, but does not manage day-to-day production. Missing information, capacity concerns, and stalled approvals must be raised early.

Obtain subcontractor, vendor, or specialty-trade proposals when outside pricing is required.

Prepare and negotiate supplements using photos, measurements, codes, manufacturer requirements, proposals, and other evidence.

Keep the current status, obstacle, next action, responsible owner, and due date updated in DASH, XactAnalysis, and other required systems.

Give customers regular updates, set realistic timelines, and raise inspection-capacity concerns before service is affected.

Notify the Reconstruction Manager when approval is likely and hand off the approved scope, estimate, budget, carrier communications, supplements, commitments, and open issues.

Keep estimates, supplements, and change documentation invoice-ready. A separate pending supplement should not delay billing for approved completed work.

headlined_rolled.desc:
About Us:

**Intermountain Electric (IME)** brings decades of experience as a trusted leader in electrical contracting. Founded in 1946, we began as a small company in Denver, CO, and have since grown to be part of the largest specialty contractor in North America. Today, we work with owners and contractors nationwide, delivering complex construction solutions across various industries, including aviation, mission critical, entertainment, and healthcare.
  
  
At IME, our people are our most valuable asset. We are committed to fostering a culture that prioritizes safety, quality, and professional growth. Joining IME is more than just finding a job—it's about building a career with opportunities to advance and make an organizational impact. Power your future with IME and be a part of a team that drives success in every project.

About this Role:

Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) is celebrating 80 years of powering progress across Colorado. Our office teams help deliver safe, smart, and reliable electrical solutions through our people and partnerships, the IME Way.

Through strategic planning, collaboration, and technical excellence, and guided by our values of Integrity, Safety, Ingenuity, Relationships, Craftsmanship, and Spark, we empower our professionals to innovate, support our field teams, and strengthen the partnerships that move our work forward.

**Project Coordinator**

Do you love communicating with clients? Do you enjoy solving problems and delighting customers? You’re who we are looking for! We are currently seeking a friendly and organized Project Coordinator to join our team. You will play a vital role in delivering excellent customer service to our clients and employees. The ideal candidate will have a professional demeanor with a casual laid back style, a quick smile, strong communication skills, and the ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently.

* Communicate with customers regarding the schedule, what to expect, etc.
* Order material and schedule deliveries.
* Obtain permits, when needed.
* Approve invoices.
* Work within our CRM to document each job.
* Communicate with superintendents daily.

* Organizational and multitasking abilities, while retaining attention to detail.
* Ability to perform your duties without being supervised (after the training period, of course).

* Health Insurance

* Paid Holidays

* Logo’d Clothing Allowance

* Wage based on experience: $25 to 32/hour with growth opportunities.

* Review and interpret construction plans, specifications, drawings, and bid documents.

* Identify potential project risks, cost-saving opportunities, and value engineering alternatives.

headlined_rolled.title: HVAC Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Overview**

As an HVAC Estimator, you’ll turn construction plans and project requirements into clear, accurate estimates for commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning work. You’ll review drawings, assess material and labor needs, develop project budgets, and coordinate pricing with clients, vendors, and project teams. Your construction estimating and project management skills will help teams make informed decisions from bid through delivery.

**Duties**

* Review blueprints and construction drawings, interpret technical details, and identify HVAC scope, quantities, and material requirements.
* Prepare estimates, pricing, and project budgets; support cost management and cost control throughout the estimating process.
* Use estimating software and spreadsheets to organize takeoffs and proposals; tools may include Bluebeam, HeavyBid, or Xactimate.
* Communicate with clients and project teams, clarify scope, and apply negotiation skills when discussing pricing and contracts.
* Coordinate with construction management and project management teams, drawing on construction site experience to support practical estimates. **Your impact:** Clear, well-supported estimates help clients and project teams plan resources and make confident project decisions.
* Ability to complete closeout documents.

**Qualifications**

* Construction estimating experience, including managing projects as a construction estimator; commercial construction estimation experience is valuable.
* Construction experience and familiarity with the construction industry, construction management, and project cost control.
* Ability to read blueprints, review construction drawings, interpret technical drawings, and estimate material requirements.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, estimating software, and construction management software; experience with Bluebeam, HeavyBid, or Xactimate is a plus.
* Strong client communication, pricing, negotiation, and contract skills.

The Commercial Waterproofing Estimator calculates the labor, equipment, and material costs for waterproofing, damproofing, air barrier, and joint sealant opportunities. **At J.R. & Co., Inc., we're not just building exteriors - we're building careers.** Established in 1986 and proudly veteran-owned, we're an energetic, optimistic, and family-oriented construction company based in Kansas City. * Prepare detailed estimates for commercial waterproofing systems, including labor, materials, equipment, and pricing
* Perform value engineering to recommend cost-effective solutions that meet client and project requirements

**Lucas Paving | Residential & Commercial Paving**

Lucas Paving is seeking an Asphalt Estimator / Sales Representative to help grow our residential and commercial paving business. We’re looking for someone who can build strong customer relationships, evaluate project needs, and prepare accurate, competitive proposals.

* Meet with homeowners, property managers, business owners, and general contractors to discuss paving needs.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Additional commission based on sales.
* Health insurance provided.
* Company truck provided.

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Construction Payroll Specialist – Union & Multi-State Payroll**

**Position Summary**

The Construction Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll for a construction workforce operating across multiple states and union jurisdictions throughout the United States. This position requires extensive involvement with union payroll, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), prevailing wage requirements, certified payroll, multi-state taxation, employee deductions, fringe benefits, and job-cost allocation.

The Payroll Specialist works closely with field personnel, project management, accounting, human resources, union representatives, and benefit funds to ensure employees are paid accurately and all payroll-related reporting and compliance requirements are satisfied.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Payroll Processing**

* Process weekly payroll for union and non-union employees across multiple states and jurisdictions.
* Review employee timecards for accuracy, approvals, job numbers, cost codes, work classifications, and applicable pay rates.
* Calculate regular wages, overtime, double time, shift premiums, travel-related compensation, and other applicable earnings.
* Maintain accurate employee payroll records, tax elections, direct deposits, deductions, and other payroll information.

headlined_rolled.title: Estimator - Hatfield Construction
headlined_rolled.desc:
**POSITION: Estimator**

**DEPARTMENT: Pre-Construction**

**REPORTS TO: Director of Pre-Construction**

**ABOUT HATFIELD CONSTRUCTION**

Hatfield Construction, a wholly owned subsidiary of Keiter Corporation, provides heavy civil, earthwork, and sitework services to clients throughout the region. For nearly two decades, we have delivered high-quality residential, commercial, and municipal projects across Western Massachusetts and Connecticut.

Our success is built on our people: skilled professionals who act with integrity, take pride in their work, and know that strong teams produce exceptional results. We are seeking an Estimator who shares these values and brings confidence, precision, and professionalism to every project.

**WHY JOIN HATFIELD**

Hatfield Construction is a growing division backed by the resources of Keiter Corporation. The Estimator will play a central role in how Hatfield prices and wins work as the division grows.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Estimator analyzes project plans, specifications, and requirements to accurately estimate construction project costs. This role involves determining the quantities and costs of materials, labor, equipment, and other resources needed to produce competitive project budgets. The Estimator collaborates closely with project managers, field operations, architects, engineers, and subcontractors to ensure accurate estimates that align with project goals and timelines. The role focuses on sitework and heavy civil work, including earthwork, site utilities, drainage, and paving, for public and private projects typically ranging from $250,000 to $5,000,000.

**ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Produce accurate estimates that align with drawings and specifications
* Manage bids from vendors and subcontractors
* Deliver estimates that track closely to final job costs
* Meet every bid deadline with complete, accurate submissions

headlined_rolled.title: Part-Time Office Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Overview**

Join our team as a Part-Time Office Assistant to help organize company records, scan paperwork, and upload and attach documents into QuickBooks and our company files.

This position is ideal for someone who is organized, comfortable using a computer, and able to handle repetitive administrative tasks accurately. Previous accounting experience is not required, but basic computer skills and familiarity with QuickBooks are a plus.

**Responsibilities**

* Answer phone systems with professional phone etiquette.
* Scan and digitize invoices, receipts, bills, and other company paperwork.
* Upload and attach scanned documents to the appropriate transactions or recrods in QuickBooks.
* Organize and maintain digital files and electronic records.
* Assist with general filing and other basic office adminstrative tasks as needed.
* Use Microsoft Office and other computer tools while protecting confidential information. Your impact: Accurate records and thoughtful client communication help colleagues work efficiently and ensure clients receive timely support.

**Experience**

* Office experience, including administrative or clerical experience, is preferred.
* Familiarity with QuickBooks, bookkeeping, Microsoft Office, and general computer skills is an asset; strong computer literacy is important.
* Demonstrated organizational skills, time management, phone communication, and careful handling of confidential information.
* Bilingual ability and personal assistant experience are nice to have, not required.

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16.0 – 24.0 per week

Work Location: In person

Keys Roofing is a fast-growing St. Louis roofing company specializing in premium roof replacements, repairs, gutters, storm restoration, and insurance claim assistance. We believe homeowners deserve exceptional service, quality materials, and honest communication from start to finish.

* Perform residential roof and gutter inspections

* Self-motivated and goal-oriented

* Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment

* Sales training and mentorship
* CRM and marketing support
* Flexible scheduling
* Supportive work environment
* A company culture built on integrity, professionalism, and growth

Why Keys Roofing?

We’re not interested in high-pressure sales tactics. We earn our reputation by providing homeowners with honest recommendations, premium workmanship, and exceptional service.

If you’re driven, professional, and ready to build a six-figure career, we’d love to talk.

Apply today.

The APM will work directly with company leadership to help manage multiple active projects, coordinate subcontractors, maintain project schedules, track costs, oversee jobsite standards, and provide professional communication to customers and trade partners.

Construction Accounting Assistant
headlined_rolled.desc:
**DESCRIPTION**

The Construction Division Accounting Assistant performs routine and repetitive clerical accounting and bookkeeping duties following established procedures. The position is responsible for verifying accuracy of amounts listed on documents, maintaining various financial records, organizing documents to proper accounts, filing records of the construction accounting/finance department, encoding information into accounting systems or computer programs, compiling routine numerical information, performing research, contract payments, and recommending changes to finance-related department/company policies and practices.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintain files and records.
* Process payables and mailing of payments.
* Data entry for different forms including excise exemption certificates.
* Pull and copy items for billings.
* Verify amounts and codes on various forms for accuracy.
* Processing reports
* Reconcile vendor statements
* Scan construction documents and email or save to various electronic folders.
* Research and special projects as assigned.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

No direct supervisory responsibilities.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Knowledge of bookkeeping practices and principles.
* Knowledge of basic math.
* Skill in maintaining accounting or bookkeeping records.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Computer literate.
* Excellent organizational and follow-through skills.
* Ability to carry out multi-task projects.
* Ability to work well with diverse groups or individuals.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

One year clerical/accounting related experience; OR any equivalent combination of experience and/or education from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.

headlined_rolled.title: Customer Service Representative- Hybrid
headlined_rolled.desc:
**DO GREAT WORK. BUILD A CAREER YOU'RE PROUD OF.**

At Loyal Plumbing, Heating & Air, we're building more than a home-services company. We're building a place where good people can do work that matters, grow their skills, and create a better future for themselves and their families.

Whether you're an experienced professional or still building your career in the trades, you'll find a team that values both technical ability and character. We believe in doing the job right, communicating clearly, respecting our customers' homes, and helping the people around us get better.

Your role matters here, and so does where it can take you. Through competitive pay, meaningful benefits, ongoing training, mentorship, and opportunities to take on more responsibility, Loyal is committed to helping great people build lasting careers.

We also believe success at work shouldn't come at the expense of life outside of it. Your time matters. Your family matters. And when you join Loyal, you're joining a team that wants you to succeed both on the job and at home.

If you're ready to do great work with good people and build a career that keeps moving forward, we'd like to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**

As a Customer Service Representative (CSR), you’re the friendly, professional first point of contact for our customers, **Monday thru Friday**. Your day-to-day will include:

* Answering incoming calls, chats, and emails using our approved greeting, tone, and procedures promptly.
* Documenting customer interactions, job notes, and scheduling details accurately.
* Provide dispatch coverage on Saturdays, coordinating service calls and assigning technicians based on urgency, location, and availability.
* Use ServiceTitan to schedule, update, and monitor service appointments while maintaining accurate customer and technician information.
* Placing outbound calls for estimates, follow-ups, membership offers, scheduling confirmations, and reminders.
* Supporting additional tasks as assigned

headlined_rolled.title: Senior Full-Charge Bookkeeper – Construction
headlined_rolled.desc:
We are seeking a highly experienced, detail-oriented **Full-Charge Bookkeeper / Accounting Specialist** to manage the day-to-day accounting operations for multiple companies.

The ideal candidate will have strong **full-cycle accounting experience**, extensive knowledge of **construction software**, and a solid background in the **construction industry**. This position requires someone who is organized, dependable, able to work independently, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

* Manage the **full accounting cycle** for multiple companies
* Handle daily bookkeeping and general ledger activity
* Manage **Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable**
* Perform bank, credit card, loan, and general ledger reconciliations
* Prepare and post journal entries and adjusting entries
* Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation
* Manage vendor accounts, customer accounts, and payment activity
* Assist with payroll-related accounting and reconciliations
* Review financial activity for accuracy and proper classification
* Complete **monthly and quarterly financial closings**
* Prepare and review Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Statements
* Maintain and reconcile balance sheet accounts
* Prepare AIA - NTO - Lien
* Prepare and maintain **Construction WIP (Work in Progress) schedules**
* Track project costs, billings, contract values, change orders, costs-to-complete, and job profitability
* Assist with percentage-of-completion and construction accounting reporting
* Work directly with management and the company's **CPA during quarterly reviews, year-end closing, tax preparation, and financial statement reviews**
* Prepare schedules and supporting documentation requested by the CPA
* Assist with year-end adjustments and ensure the books are properly closed and ready for tax preparation
* Maintain organized accounting files and financial records
* Identify discrepancies and resolve accounting issues promptl

We are looking for a Receptionist to manage our front desk on a daily basis and to perform a variety of administrative and clerical tasks. As a Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for our company. Our Receptionist’s duties include offering administrative support across the organization. To be successful as a Receptionist, you should have a pleasant personality, as this is also a customer service role. * Ensure reception area is tidy and presentable, with all necessary stationery and material (e.g. pens, forms and brochures)
* Provide basic and accurate information in-person and via phone/email
* Receive, sort and distribute daily mail/deliveries
* Maintain office security by following safety procedures and controlling access via the reception desk (monitor logbook, issue visitor badges)
* Order front office supplies and keep inventory of stock
* Update calendars and schedule meetings
* Arrange travel and accommodations, and prepare vouchers
* Keep updated records of office expenses and costs
* Perform other clerical receptionist duties such as filing, photocopying, transcribing and faxing

**Job Description**

Growing Custom Home Builder has a position open to fill multiple roles as a Bookkeeper and Construction Office Manager. A background in contract administration, development coordination, title/escrow coordination, bookkeeping, or a similar position is recommended. Our Southern UT-based company is a small, fast-paced custom home construction company developing residential projects in Southern Utah.

The applicant must be well-versed in the general contracting industry. Primary Construction Office Manager responsibilities include handling all aspects of contract administration for the general contracting portion of our business including tracking bid documents, subcontractor contracts, insurance certificates, vendor contracts, pay requests, lien releases, bank draw submittals and project close-out documentation, meeting coordination, purchase contract tracking, permit submittals and tracking, and bookkeeping responsibilities; data entry, bank reconciliation, payroll, and monthly reports.

Secondary responsibilities include acting as executive/personal assistant to the owners, and overall office management, weekly preparation of financial analysis reports for weekly review.

The applicant should be highly organized, detail-oriented, and have strong coordination skills. Exceptional communication skills (especially writing) are a must. The applicant must be punctual, a self-starter, and able to meet deadlines for completing projects.

Time management is critically important. Experience with Excel and Quickbooks is required. Experience with project management software such as BuilderTrend and graphic design experience (Photoshop, Indesign, Sketchup, etc.) is also a plus. A general understanding of office equipment (copiers, scanners, printers, conference calls, scheduling, etc.) is expected.

This position will most likely grow into more hours weekly as the company grows.

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Overview:**

This is a high pressure job, and a great one.

Our Project Coordinator keeps every signed job moving, from contract to final invoice: roof replacements and repairs, insurance claims, water and mold losses, commercial and property management work, solar, and interior rebuilds, all at once. The phone does not stop, homeowners want answers today, adjusters take their time, and crews need materials yesterday.

It sounds busy, and it is. We are also constantly growing and improving our AI team to take repetitive tasks and communication follow up off your plate, so your time goes to the work that needs a person. If that sounds like your kind of day, keep reading.

**What You Will Do:**

* Schedule production across our crews and subcontractors, and make sure the paperwork is complete before a job goes on the calendar.
* Coordinate our sales reps’ schedules and our supervision schedule: inspections, appointments, and supervisor site visits at start, during the job, and at final walk.
* Order measurements and materials, and sequence the other trades on restoration jobs: flooring, drywall, paint, cabinets, HVAC, packout and abatement.
* Keep every job file current in AccuLynx. If it is not in AccuLynx, it did not happen.
* Keep insurance jobs moving: work with adjusters, carriers and third parties, and gather the photos and documents a supplement needs.
* Review subcontractor and supplier invoices, and keep job costs lined up between AccuLynx and QuickBooks.
* Be the customer’s day to day contact, often during the worst week of their year. Stay calm and keep them informed.
* Handle change orders, close jobs out, and work every day alongside our AI team.

*Why it is hard:* Volume surges in hail and monsoon season, constant interruptions, and real accountability. A missed delivery or a missed line on a supplement costs money and a customer’s trust.

North Oaks, Minnesota | On-Site | Part-Time (~20-30 hrs/week), Hourly | $27–$34/hour

Michels Homes is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Construction Accounting Specialist to support the financial and administrative side of our residential construction business. This part-time role connects accounting with day-to-day construction operations, helping ensure our jobs, vendors, subcontractors, purchase orders, billing, and financial records stay accurate and organized.

* Process accounts payable, vendor bills, and subcontractor invoices.

* Process payments and maintain organized payment records.
* Collect W-9s, set up vendors, and maintain subcontractor/vendor records.
* Track certificates of insurance (COIs), insurance compliance, and lien waivers.
* Maintain accurate information between JobTread and QuickBooks Online.
* Assist in administration of purchase orders and help maintain complete project financial records.
* Assist with customer billing, including progress/draw invoices, change order billing, and tracking receivables.
* Code company credit card transactions and receipts, and assist with month-end reconciliations.
* Support general construction office operations and project administration as needed.

* Construction accounting or construction office experience preferred.
* Experience with QuickBooks Online and job costing; familiarity with JobTread construction management software is a plus.
* Working knowledge of accounts payable, purchase orders, vendor/subcontractor management, and lien waivers.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to independently follow tasks through to completion.

Mosher Accounting Group is a growing bookkeeping and accounting services firm seeking an experienced Senior Bookkeeper to join our remote team.

* Complete monthly close procedures accurately and within established deadlines.
* Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation.
* Identify and resolve bookkeeping issues rather than simply processing transactions.
* Assist with cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping projects as needed.

headlined_rolled.desc:
**About our Company**

Woman-owned dirt-work and pipeline contractor in the Central Valley. We do grade and earthwork, billed by the yard and sometimes by the hour on tractors and scrapers, and irrigation and pond pipeline work. We are small. The owner still bids, runs jobs, and makes the decisions. This person takes over the desk, so jobs get estimated, tracked, billed, and costed without things sitting in a pile.

**What you will do:**

* Build and track estimates in QuickBooks and Excel for dirt work (quantities, haul, equipment hours, yardage) and pipeline (pipe, fittings, structures, labor, equipment).
* Turn field tickets, material invoices, and sub bills into job costs.
* Enter and reconcile jobs in QuickBooks Desktop and Excel. Code costs to the right job. Produce invoices from the estimate or from time-and-material tickets.
* Track active jobs: percent complete, change orders, what has been billed, what is still owed, and what the job is making.
* Follow up on past-due invoices.
* Keep vendor and customer files, lien releases, and job folders in order.
* Prepare simple job-cost and cash reports for the owner each week.
* Answer calls, schedule material deliveries, and coordinate with operators and subcontractors.
* Occasional site visits to confirm quantities or pick up tickets.

**What you need:**

* Solid QuickBooks Desktop. Construction or job-costing use is a plus. We are not on QuickBooks Online.
* Strong Excel: formulas, lookups, and clean tracking sheets. Not just data entry. You may need to build an Excel book to track jobs if the one we have is not adequate.
* At least two years in a construction office, bookkeeping, estimating support, or project admin role.
* Comfort with numbers, deadlines, and messy field paperwork.
* Reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license.
* Able to work on-site in Hanford during business hours.

headlined_rolled.title: Bookkeeper - Construction and Property Management
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Full-Charge Bookkeeper - Construction and Property Management**

Full-time | Buffalo area, in office | $60,000 to $67,000

We are a family-owned homebuilder and commercial property owner in Western New York, with commercial buildings, apartment communities, and self-storage across New York and Florida. We are adding a bookkeeper to own the accounting for our property entities and the payables function for the group.

**The role**

* Monthly accounting for the commercial, apartment, storage, and Florida entities: financial statements, common area maintenance reconciliations, tenant statements, receivables follow-up, management fee billing, and lender reporting.
* Invoice entry and payment across all entities, including utilities and property taxes.
* The payables cycle for the group: invoice review, vendor setup, statement reconciliation, and the weekly check run.
* Purchase orders and job cost coding, working directly with our estimating group.
* Work in process cash reporting, Forms 1099, and insurance audits.

**How the first year works**

You would begin with the payables cycle, purchase orders, and job cost coding, add the property transactions and the periodic reporting within the first quarter, and take on the monthly property accounting through the balance of the year. You would work alongside our senior bookkeeper, who handles payroll, construction draws, and contract administration through closing.

**What we are looking for**

* Five or more years in bookkeeping, including month-end close and financial statement preparation.
* QuickBooks. Construction, real estate, or property management experience is a strong plus.
* Someone who wants to own a function end to end rather than work one piece of it.

**Compensation and benefits**

$60,000 to start, moving to $67,000 over the first year as responsibilities transfer. Full-time, in office, with benefits.

headlined_rolled.title: Dispatcher
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Job Summary:**

As a Dispatcher, you will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating field services for specific lines of business within the company. Your primary objective will be to ensure the accurate, profitable, and timely fulfillment of customer commitments. This role involves effectively managing resources, including personnel and equipment, to meet operational and budgetary goals. You will play a critical role in optimizing efficiency and maintaining high standards of service delivery while fostering a collaborative and productive work environment among team members.

**Essential Functions****:**

* Foster team morale and promote a collaborative work environment.
* Provide coaching, implement disciplinary actions, and facilitate performance improvement initiatives.
* Monitor and manage expenditures within assigned budgetary constraints.
* Effectively communicate work priorities, including scheduling daily assignments.
* Ensure compliance with Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations.
* Maintain accurate inventory records for materials, products, and vehicles.
* Uphold Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) compliance standards.
* Ensure employees maintain and service equipment to meet safety standards.
* Obtain and sign power permits as required.
* Verify completed work against contract specifications and payment sheets.
* Maintain and update Dispatch Log throughout the day.
* Receive, record COD payments, and confirm transactions with customers.
* Plan and coordinate routes for the following day's contracts.
* Prepare Load Sheets and requisitions for materials.
* Inspect truckloads for accuracy and safety before departure.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.

headlined_rolled.title: Asphalt and Concrete Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
Neyra Paving is a commercial asphalt paving, concrete and pavement maintenance contractor serving the Greater Cincinnati area. Founded in 1965, we have grown into one of Cincinnati's most respected contractors.

We are looking for an Estimator to join our team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a Construction Management, Civil Engineering or related background who is detail-oriented, technically strong and interested in building a career in the construction industry.

**Previous estimating experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to train the right person.**

What You'll Do

The primary responsibility of this position is to review construction plans and specifications and provide our project managers with accurate quantities and complete scope information.

Our project managers are responsible for final job pricing. Your responsibility is making sure they have accurate information to price the project correctly.

Responsibilities include:

* Review civil/site construction plans, drawings and specifications
* Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for asphalt paving, concrete and related site work
* Calculate areas, lengths, volumes and material quantities
* Identify pavement depths, asphalt mix requirements, concrete specifications and other project requirements
* Review project specifications, details, notes and addenda
* Identify potential scope gaps, unusual requirements and conflicts within the plans
* Prepare clear, organized takeoff packages for project managers
* Communicate questions or concerns discovered during plan review
* Maintain accurate electronic estimating files and documentation
* Work with project managers and field personnel to understand how projects are actually constructed
* Occasionally visit jobsites to develop a better understanding of field conditions, construction methods and production

Strong candidates will have:

* Bachelor's or associate degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Construction

**Residential Estate Landscape Maintenance Account Manager**

**Cultivate Relationships. Steward Exceptional Gardens. Lead with Expertise.**

**Job Summary**

As a **Residential Estate Landscape Maintenance Account Manager**, you are the trusted steward of some of our most distinctive private landscapes. This role is rooted in **fine gardening and horticultural excellence**, not commercial groundskeeping. You will oversee a portfolio of high-end residential properties, guiding the long-term health, beauty, and evolution of each garden.

You’ll partner closely with homeowners and estate managers, lead skilled gardening crews, and apply horticultural knowledge to elevate plant performance, seasonal interest, and overall garden quality. This is a hands-on, relationship-driven role for someone who values detail, plant care, and pride of workmanship.

You won’t just manage maintenance — you’ll **care for living landscapes**, mentor gardeners, and help properties reach their full potential.

**What You’ll Do**

* Serve as the primary account manager for assigned **residential estate gardens**, building trust through expertise, responsiveness, and discretion
* Develop and refine **customized garden maintenance plans** based on plant needs, seasonal cycles, and client goals
* Conduct regular, detailed property walks focused on **plant health, pruning quality, soil conditions, and aesthetic standards**
* Proactively identify horticultural issues and opportunities, offering thoughtful recommendations to enhance garden performance
* Cultivate relationships with clients by communicating clearly and professionally regarding plant care, seasonal priorities, and long-term garden planning
* Lead, coach, & mentor fine gardening crews, reinforcing horticultural best practices, craftsmanship, teamwork & safety
* Perform quality inspections to ensure work reflects high-end residential estate standards
* Manage account budgets related to routine maintenance as well as enhancement work

Partners In Construction is a residential general contractor. We rehabilitate, reconstruct, and elevate homes for disaster-recovery and housing programs across Florida and Georgia. headlined_rolled.title: Commission Sales Rep - Hotel HVAC Replacements (NJ) - Leads Provided
headlined_rolled.desc:
Power Air is an HVAC company replacing old PTAC units (the through-the-wall AC/heating units in hotel rooms) at hotels and motels across New Jersey.

This is an easy conversation to start. A utility rebate covers up to 80% of the replacement cost, and the rest goes on a 0% interest 60-month plan through the hotel's electric bill. The owner pays $0 down, and the energy savings on the new units cover the monthly payment from the first bill. You are not asking anyone for money - you are showing them a lower bill.

The job:

- Call and visit hotels and motels across NJ

- Book walkthroughs for our team

- Follow up and help close

We give you a researched list of 177 hotels already sorted by utility territory. The hotels and motels on the list range from 80 to 200 rooms. We also provide a call script that works.

Pay: $75 per PTAC unit sold, 100% commission, no cap.

An 80-room hotel is $6,000 to you. A 200-room hotel is $15,000. One good week can be one hotel.

You are a fit if:

- You have done commission sales or cold calling before

- You are comfortable walking into a hotel and asking for the general manager

- You have a car and can cover NJ

Reply with a few lines about your sales background and your phone number. If it sounds like a fit, we will set up a short call.

Pay: $6,000.00 - $15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

*RJS Grading | Raleigh, North Carolina*

You will give our financial officer Erin dependable support and a clear view of what needs attention.

**Company**
-----------

RJS Grading is a Raleigh, North Carolina-based civil excavation and underground utility contractor. Our work includes grading, sitework, utilities, clearing, demolition, hauling, and related site services. We value people who own the outcome, communicate early and honestly, take pride in the work, protect our people, and grow together. You will work directly with ownership and help build dependable office and project routines in a small company where your work is visible.

---------------------------

* Maintain job folders, contracts, permits, insurance certificates, W-9s, lien waivers, change logs, and closeout records. Flag missing paperwork early.
* Track bid invitations and deadlines, organize plans and addenda, request quotes, and coordinate submission of approved proposals.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales Manager to lead our sales team and drive business growth. headlined_rolled.title: IN-HOUSE ESTIMATOR
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Commercial Carpentry | Morris County NJ**

We are looking for a motivated professional who understands commercial construction, can accurately interpret construction drawings, and can prepare competitive, detailed estimates to support our bidding and project planning process.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Perform detailed quantity takeoffs from architectural and construction drawings.
* Prepare accurate material, labor, and overall project cost estimates.
* Utilize AI and Pro Core for digital takeoffs, estimating, and bid preparation.
* Review plans, specifications, and addenda to identify project requirements.
* Estimate commercial carpentry scopes, including metal and wood framing, drywall, ceilings, doors and hardware, blocking, backing, millwork, and finish carpentry.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and suppliers to obtain competitive pricing.
* Identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and potential cost-saving opportunities.
* Prepare organized, detailed bid proposals and estimate breakdowns.
* Meet bid deadlines while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Proven experience estimating commercial carpentry projects.
* Strong working knowledge of **AI and Pro Core** and digital estimating tools.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, specifications, and construction documents.
* Knowledge of commercial carpentry construction materials, labor production rates, and installation methods.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple bid deadlines.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

A reliable estimating professional who takes pride in accuracy, understands the commercial carpentry trade, and can help us pursue projects with confidence and competitive pricing.

The Estimator prepares accurate, complete, and competitive estimates and proposals from initial budgeting through bid submission and project handoff. Working with owners, design teams, trade partners, and Rabren’s operations teams, this position evaluates scope, costs, and risks and provides clear pricing information in accordance with Rabren Best Practices.

**Build Safer Homes and Stronger Communities in Southwest Florida**

Rebuilding Together Greater Florida is seeking a Construction Coordinator based in Sarasota to help manage residential repair and rehabilitation projects for homeowners in need.

This is a hands-on coordination role that combines fieldwork and project management. You will work directly with contractors, homeowners, inspectors, and internal teams to help ensure home repairs are completed safely, efficiently, and with high quality.

Every project completed helps a homeowner live in a safer and healthier home.

**Quick Position Snapshot**

Salary: $50,000 – $58,000

Role Type: Field and Office

**About Rebuilding Together Greater Florida (RTGFL)**

Rebuilding Together Greater Florida (formerly Rebuilding Together Tampa Bay) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to repairing homes, revitalizing communities, and rebuilding lives.

Serving 21 counties across Florida, RTGFL provides safe and healthy housing for low-income homeowners, seniors, veterans, and families in need. Through home rehabilitation, disaster recovery programs, and community revitalization initiatives, we help ensure homeowners can remain safely in the homes they love.

**Position Overview**

The Construction Coordinator helps manage residential repair and rehabilitation projects from initial home assessment through final inspection and project completion.

This role requires a balance of field visits and project coordination, including evaluating homes, verifying scopes of work, monitoring construction progress, coordinating contractors, and ensuring projects meet program and funding requirements.

The Construction Coordinator works closely with the Construction Manager and District Program team to ensure projects remain organized, compliant, and on schedule.

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Construction Estimator – Restoration and Reconstruction**

**Position Summary**

The Construction Estimator prepares accurate repair, and reconstruction estimates for residential and commercial properties damaged by water, wind, fire, smoke, and other covered losses. This position uses Xactimate or Symbility to develop detailed scopes of work and manages estimates from initial inspection through revisions, approval, and final billing. The ideal candidate understands construction methods, building materials, trade sequencing, and

labor costs. Experience estimating drywall, painting, flooring, cabinetry, trim, doors, windows,

roofing, and other structural and finish repairs is preferred.

This is primarily an office-based position, with field inspections and site measurements as needed. Strong organization, communication, and attention to detail are essential, along with the ability to manage multiple projects across different geographic locations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare detailed, line-item construction estimates in Xactimate or Symbility for repair and reconstruction projects.
* Inspect properties, take measurements, and review photographs, sketches, reports, and project documentation to establish the repair scope.
* Identify the labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and permits needed to complete each project.
* Develop scopes that address documented damage and the work necessary to return properties to their pre-loss condition.
* Coordinate with project managers, field personnel, and subcontractors to verify repair methods, quantities, site conditions, and project requirements.

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Coordinator
headlined_rolled.desc:
**Construction Projects Coordinator**

We’re looking for an organized, dependable coordinator to support construction projects from award through completion. This role keeps schedules, materials, permits, and project information moving and up to date while coordinating with customers, vendors, and field teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate project schedules, deadlines, and updates with field staff and customers.
* Track project status, action items, and key dates in the project management system.
* Help order and track materials, deliveries, and equipment.
* Coordinate permit applications, required documents, and follow-ups.
* Maintain organized project files, notes, and records.
* Communicate changes, delays, and outstanding items to the appropriate people.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable using email, spreadsheets, and project tracking software.
* Able to manage several projects and deadlines at once.
* Construction or project coordination experience is preferred.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Houston, TX 77095

**Get into heavy civil estimating with room to grow beyond the junior seat.**

**About Sunset Valley Construction**

We’re a sitework and underground utilities contractor focused on building and maintaining essential infrastructure. We’re projecting to double in size over the next four years and are looking to build out our estimating and preconstruction team to support that growth.

This position is designed for someone earlier in their construction career who has a solid foundation and wants to learn heavy civil estimating, takeoffs, and preconstruction from an experienced team.

**How You’ll Contribute**

As a Junior Estimator / Preconstruction Engineer, you’ll work alongside the owner and estimating/project management team to support the front end of our projects.

You don’t need to walk in knowing how to build a complete heavy civil estimate. You'll use your basic understanding of construction fundamentals, plans, heavy equipment and site construction while we teach you takeoffs, estimating, production rates, pricing, and how real estimates get built before the work reaches the field.

**Growth Opportunity**

This is not intended to be a career-long junior position. As you develop, you’ll take on more complex takeoffs, estimates, and preconstruction responsibilities.

Depending on your strengths and interests, this position can grow toward Estimator, Senior Estimator, Project Engineer, Assistant Project Manager, Project Manager, or Preconstruction Manager. Your growth will be driven by your ability to learn the work, produce accurate information, and become someone the estimating, project management, and field teams can rely on.

* Build a stronger takeoff foundation by learning to perform quantity takeoffs for earthwork, utilities, drainage, site concrete, paving, and other heavy civil/sitework scopes.

* Source and evaluate vendors based on price, reliability, and performance.
* Negotiate pricing, cash discounts, and volume purchase agreements.
* Provide updates on material availability and pricing changes to key stakeholders.
* Maintain and enforce purchasing documentation standards, including terms and conditions.
* Track and maintain records of vendor performance and price histories.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field preferred. In lieu of a degree, 6+ years of relevant purchasing experience will be considered
* 3+ years of purchasing experience, ideally within the construction or steel indus

* Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines
* Comfortable working independently
* Concrete and/or masonry estimating experience is strongly preferred

**Schedule:** Flexible

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Note:** This is an early posting for a January or February 2027 opening. However, an earlier start may become necessary.

**About TCE**

TCE is a 40+ person civil and structural subcontractor performing earthwork, utilities, concrete, and site work in the commercial and custom home spaces within the bay area.

**About the role**

The Finance & Compliance Manager owns TCE's financial health and regulatory standing. You'll run accounting and cash management, oversee billing and job costing, and keep insurance, licensing, and bonding current. This is a hands-on role at a growing company: you'll do the work, improve the systems behind it, and give ownership the numbers it needs to make decisions. The back office is already built, with established systems and documented processes, and the role is a chance to take it to the next level with WIP reporting, cash forecasting, and stronger controls. We are looking for someone who can self manage and is also comfortable with task delegation as needed.

**Key responsibilities**

**Accounting and reporting**

* Own the books in QuickBooks Online: New vendor set up (including W9 collection), chart of accounts, job cost allocations, monthly bank and credit card reconciliations
* Prepare the monthly close package: P&L, job cost review, AR aging, AP schedule, and projections
* Build and maintain work-in-progress (WIP) schedules; flag over- and under-billing and margin fade
* Pay and plan for taxes in coordination with CPA
* Coordinate with procurement and project management to keep job costing accurate: cost coding, committed costs, and change orders
* Coordinate with the outside CPA on year-end, tax planning, and financial statements for bonding and credit if needed
* Lead financing efforts for equipment and vehicles
* Maintain fixed asset/purchases register and debt spreadsheet
* Daily treasury management/positive pay ownership

**Cash, payables, and receivables**

* Enter Invoices into Quickbooks
* Approve vendor invoices agains

As a Commercial Site Work Estimator, you’ll turn project plans into clear, well-supported estimates that help teams make informed decisions and deliver successful commercial construction work. NOW HIRING: Construction Project Estimating/Office Assistant

**Turner Construction Group**  
**Location:** Elkton, Virginia  
**Position Type:** Full-Time

Position Overview

Turner Construction Group is seeking a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented Construction Project Estimating Assistant to support our project estimators with daily administrative tasks, bid preparation, and construction project documentation.

The ideal candidate will have current or previous experience in the general construction industry, be familiar with construction management software, and have the ability to manage multiple tasks while meeting deadlines. This position is ideal for someone who understands construction terminology and enjoys working behind the scenes to help projects run smoothly from the estimating and bidding stages through project startup.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist project estimators with preparing bids, estimates, and proposals.
* Use Procore software to access project information, drawings, specifications, and other construction documents.
* Review bid invitations and help organize project requirements and deadlines.
* Assist with quantity takeoffs, material lists, and pricing documentation as needed.
* Request and organize quotes from subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors.
* Download, organize, and maintain construction plans, drawings, specifications, and addenda.
* Prepare bid packages and compile supporting documentation for project submissions.
* Assist with uploading bid documents and maintaining accurate project records.
* Communicate with vendors, subcontractors, and other team members to obtain project information.
* Maintain organized electronic and paper files.
* Assist with general office and administrative duties related to estimating and project coordination.
* Perform other duties as needed to support the estimating team.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Current or previous general construction knowledge or experience is required.**

Vallencourt Construction Co., Inc. is seeking an experienced, dependable, and detail-oriented Parts Purchasing Specialist to join our parts department.

headlined_rolled.desc:
Veregy is an award-winning NAESCO-Accredited decarbonization company focusing on accelerating and simplifying Energy Transition. We provide turnkey engineering and construction services designed to reduce our clients' energy and operating costs through the implementation of energy efficiency and infrastructure upgrades, smart building technology, fleet EV infrastructure, clean energy generation, and sustainability.

**About Us**

Veritas Consulting & Construction Group is a family-owned residential roofing and remodeling contractor based in Hallsville, serving Columbia and central Missouri. We're a small team of about 14 people, and our office runs on accuracy, follow-through, and people who take ownership of their work.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Head Bookkeeper to take over our company books from ownership. This is a hands-on role: you'll own the general ledger, reconciliations, month-end close, job costing, and work with our outside CPA firm.

We'll be upfront: you won't start there. Our day-to-day bookkeeping is currently shared between ownership and our Accounting & Sales Support Coordinator, so you'll learn the business from the ground up first. That means you'll know every part of our accounting workflow and can run any of it when needed. Here's how it works:

**How You'll Grow Into the Role**

* Phase 2 — Cover (about 6 weeks in early 2027): Run the Coordinator role independently while a team member is on a planned leave.
* Phase 3 — Re-sync: Work side-by-side with the Coordinator when they return to hand the work back and catch up on anything that changed.
* Phase 4 — Step into Head Bookkeeper: Ownership divides the shared duties between the two roles and trains you on the rest of the Head Bookkeeper work: month-end close, WIP reporting, journal entries, the monthly meeting with our CPA, year-end, and insurance audit schedules. Once the Coordinator duties are fully handed back, your pay moves to $25/hr.

Construction Office Manager

**Vici Construction · Sherrills Ford, NC · Full-time · $25–32/hour**

**What this job actually is**

We are a construction company. You would run the office side of it — permits, payroll, invoicing, vendor and material orders, tool inventory, and getting new crew members set up and ready to work on day one. When the office work is handled you will be in a company truck: marking locates, dropping a sign at a job we are starting, running materials out to a crew.

This is not a front-desk job, and it is not a job where you finish a task and wait to be told the next one. On a good day nobody has to ask you for a status, because the system is already current and you have already flagged the thing that is about to go sideways.

* Permit applications and inspection requests, county by county
* Timesheet review and bi-weekly payroll submission
* Project invoicing and weekly account balancing in our in-house system
* Material orders to vendors; delivery dates tracked into the project schedule

* Sourcing trade, material, and maintenance vendors
* Keeping the crew schedule current in our system
* Certificates of insurance current for every active sub and vendor
* Pulling lien agents and keeping project documentation filed

Demo & Construction Cleaning Crew Lead

headlined_rolled.title: Construction Project Coordinator/Office Manager
headlined_rolled.desc:
Weis Builders is a premier construction company with over 85 years of delivering high-quality projects that make a lasting impact on communities. We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Construction Project Coordinator / Office Manager to support our construction operations and manage the day-to-day administrative functions of our office.

  

This position serves as an important link between project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, clients, and the office. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple priorities, following up on outstanding items, maintaining accurate project documentation, and helping ensure that both our projects and office operate efficiently.

Success in this role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, follow-through, and the ability to anticipate what needs to happen next rather than simply reacting to requests.

  

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Provide administrative and coordination support to project managers and field personnel throughout the construction process.
* Assist with project startup, contact lists, distribution lists, and document-control procedures.
* Maintain organized project records.
* Assist with preparation, tracking, and distribution of contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, change orders, insurance certificates, and other project documentation.
* Track subcontractor and vendor documentation and follow up on outstanding items.
* Assist with project correspondences.
* Assist with meeting preparation, agendas, meeting minutes, and distribution of action items.
* Coordinate communication among project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, design professionals, and other project stakeholders.
* Assist with project closeout, including punch lists, warranties, operation and maintenance manuals, as-built documentation, lien waivers, and other required closeout materials.
* Monitor deadlines and proactively follow up with responsible parties

headlined_rolled.title: Preconstruction Mechanical / Utility Estimator
headlined_rolled.desc:
Wharton-Smith, Inc., a highly regarded construction company, is seeking qualified candidates for a Preconstruction Mechanical/Utility Estimator position. This position is located in our Corporate office in Sanford, FL.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**  

* Ability to read and review drawings, specifications and reports
* Perform quantity take-off of Pipe & Appurtenances, requiring quantity counts, measurements and determining material types
* Calculating labor and equipment costs for self performed work for all types of jobsite conditions
* Ability to identify risks including utility conflicts, dewatering needs, excavation protection and other temporary measures needed for a complete piping installation
* Solicit Subcontractor/Supplier participation via phone and/or E-mail.
* Developing and maintaining long term beneficial relationships with key vendors and subcontractors
* Proficient in scope analysis and ability to estimate deficiencies as needed
* Projects ranging from 4 Million to 400 Million with hard deadlines and must be able to multi-task efficiently.
* Attend Pre-Bid Meetings as needed.
* Writing RFI’s along with clarifications and assumptions.

**Preferences/Qualifications:**  

* 3-4 years of underground mechanical estimating or similar field experience.
* Previous experience with hard bid Municipal utility projects is a plus.

headlined_rolled.title: Roofing Sales Representative
headlined_rolled.desc:
### **Description**

Looking for a career where your effort directly impacts your income?

Worthmann Roofing is hiring motivated individuals who want to build a rewarding career in roofing and home improvement sales. Whether you're an experienced sales professional or looking for a new opportunity, we'll provide the training, support, and appointments needed to help you succeed.  
  
Worthmann Roofing is a leading residential roofing and exterior remodeling company committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences and high-quality workmanship. We help homeowners protect and improve their homes through roofing and gutter solutions backed by industry-leading warranties and expert installation teams.

As we continue expanding into new and existing markets, we're looking for ambitious sales professionals who want to grow with us and build a rewarding long-term career.

* First-year earning potential of $125,000 to $250,000+
* Uncapped commissions
* Company-provided appointments
* No cold calling or door knocking
* Paid training and ongoing coaching
* Clear opportunities for advancement
* W-2 position with benefits and paid time off

At Worthmann Roofing, you'll join a growing team that values hard work, integrity, and professional growth. If you're ready to take control of your income and build a long-term career, we'd love to hear from you.
