* Conduct 10 to 15 pre-scheduled and confirmed in-home appointments per week - *No cold calling or door knocking required*
* Earn more commission for self-generated business
* Drive to pre-set appointments
* Complete a thorough two week training program with our dedicated sales training team
* Attend weekly sales meetings
* Additional responsibilities as assigned by leadership

### **What We're Looking For**

  

* Ability to work a 5 day work week between Monday-Saturday, *Saturdays are mandatory*

**Job Posting: Payroll & Accounting Coordinator**

**Industry:** Oil & Gas / Construction  
**Department:** Accounting & Finance  
**Reports To:** Controller / Accounting Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Granbury, Tx  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience

**Position Summary**

At Xccelerated Construction Unlimited, we are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Payroll & Accounting Coordinator to support payroll processing and daily accounting operations for our oil and gas and construction activities. This position plays an important role in ensuring accurate and timely payroll for field and office employees, maintaining job cost records, processing vendor and subcontractor invoices, and supporting financial reporting.

The ideal candidate will have experience working in a construction, oilfield services, or industrial environment and understand the importance of accurate labor reporting, job costing, expense tracking, and meeting strict payroll and accounting deadlines.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Payroll & Timekeeping**

* Process weekly payroll for field personnel, drivers, equipment operators, and office staff.
* Review and verify employee timesheets, electronic time entries, daily field tickets, and supervisor-approved hours.
* Ensure accurate recording of regular hours, overtime, per-dem, travel time, bonuses, and other applicable pay items.
* Allocate labor hours and labor costs to the appropriate jobs, projects, work orders, cost codes, and departments.
* Verifies deductions, reimbursements, and payroll changes.
* Reconcile payroll reports and payroll-related general ledger accounts.
* Assist with payroll tax reporting, quarterly filings, year-end processing, and W-2 preparation.
* Respond to employee and supervisor questions regarding payroll, timekeeping, and pay discrepancies.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of payroll and employee information.

headlined_rolled.desc:
**Remodeling Sales Representative (Basements)**  
YMC Construction | Chicago, IL  
Commission: 5% per closed job (You can make $1,000 to $2,500 per job)  
Job type: 1099 Independent Contractor

**About Us**

YMC Construction is a Chicago remodeling company specializing in basement finishing and remodeling. We generate and qualify our own leads, and our crews handle all construction. We're looking for an experienced sales rep to run in-home estimates and close jobs.

**About the Role**

This is a sales only role. You will not do any construction work. Every appointment is pre-booked and pre-qualified by our office team. Your job is to meet the homeowner, assess the space, price the project, and close. Once the contract is signed, our team takes it from there.

**Responsibilities**

* Run in-home estimates for basement remodeling projects
* Measure and scope each project accurately
* Price jobs and present proposals using our CRM
* Answer homeowner questions on design, layout, permits, and timelines
* Follow up with homeowners until a decision is made

**Requirements**

* Proven experience building or selling remodeling projects (required)
* Ability to scope and price a basement remodel on site
* Comfortable selling projects of $20,000 and up
* Reliable vehicle and valid driver's license
* Comfortable using a smartphone and a CRM
* Located in or near Chicago

**What We Offer**

* 5% commission on every closed job, you can make $1,000 to $2,500 per job
* No cap on earnings
* Pre-booked, pre-qualified appointments
* No construction or project management, just selling
* CRM with built-in estimating tools, proposals, and e-sign contracts
* Office support for appointment reminders and homeowner follow-up
* Flexible schedule

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed and include a short note on your remodeling experience, including the largest project you've sold or built.

Pay: $50.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
